ID_BUILDING_MAJOR_GROUP_SCENERY_LIGHTS_S: Scenery: Stairs, Greenery, Lights and Furniture

ID_BUILDING_TYPE_5CARDSTUD_DESC: A game for serious gamblers! Make sure you have some high stakes tables.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_ALACARTERESTAURANT_DESC: A high-class restaurant that appeals to the richer clientele. If you can afford it, why not upgrade with a Celebrity Chef?
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_AQUARIUM_DESC: An oasis of calm for families and older guests.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_ARCADE_DESC: Video Games! A regular haunt for kids, especially the boys, to hand over piles of quarters!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_ARENA_DESC: Having an Arena will allow you to stage some of the biggest shows in town! But be warned: if you can't attract performers, it'll burn a pretty big hole in your pocket!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_ARTGALLERY_DESC: Filled with old masters and modern classics, the Art Gallery presents the ultimate in collectibles for the discerning buyer. This shop will only interest the richest of your guests.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_ATM_DESC: These will allow your patrons to get access to their hard earned savings.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_BACCARAT_DESC: Baccarat is a game of chance preferred by the more sophisticated guests.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_BAR_DESC: The Bar serves alcoholic beverages and appeals to pretty much everyone. Use the Music Upgrades to focus the Bar's appeal and the Waitress Service to satisfy choosier customers.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_BEAUTYPARLOUR_DESC: Ladies! This is a great place to get a makeover. Feel good, look great!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_BENCH_DESC: These benches will give your customers a welcome break as they admire your attractions. For maximum relaxation, why not surround them with trees and other choice scenery?
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_BIN_DESC: Placing bins at strategic points will help your cleaners keep on top of the garbage problem.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_BLACKJACK_DESC: Blackjack is one of the most popular games, with a very wide appeal.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_BUFFET_DESC: Supplying food inside your Casino will stop guests searching further afield for refreshments and encourage them to spend more time at the tables and machines. Remember to build a Kitchen to supply your buffet!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_CARIBBEANSTUD_DESC: Poker, with a Caribbean flavor. Another perennial favorite for the casual gambler.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_CARJACKPOTSLOTGROUP_DES: This is a pretty sweet set-up, where the jackpot prize is a car! Pretty snazzy, right? Choose which type of vehicle you want to feature in the Upgrades Menu. This decision will determine who will be most attracted to these slots!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_CARPARK_DESC: Building a Car Park will help attract people to your Lot. Adding the Taxi or Limo Hire upgrades will further broaden your appeal!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_CASHIERSDESK_DESC: When your guests run out of cash they can use this service to increase their bankroll. With this building, you can also hire Cashier's Assistants to maintain the Slots and Video machines. Pretty useful!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_CINEMA_DESC: Pull the punters in with the latest blockbusters! Although it's not the most exciting venue on the Strip, it will keep those on a budget entertained.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_CIRCUS_DESC: The Circus is always a winner with the kids, especially if you add a Clown Workshop. Hiring an International Troupe will create a wider appeal.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_COCKTAILBAR_DESC: The Cocktail Bar supplies expensive alcoholic drinks that will appeal to your richer guests. Adding waitresses and a little background music may enhance the atmosphere.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_COFFEEBAR_DESC: The Soda Bar supplies drinks for children and families: all strictly non-alcoholic, of course.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_CONVENTIONCENTRE_DESC: The Business Center, with its plush meeting rooms and conference facilities, will attract business guests to your lot. Once you have them, make sure they leave with emptied pockets!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_CRAPS_DESC: Craps: Throw dice, win money. Simple.  A very social and noisy game!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_CRECHE_DESC: Somewhere to offload the kids! If you want to attract families to your Lot, the Creche will help no end.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_DISPLAYSTAGE_DESC: Attract guests to your complex with fabulous firework displays! Ooh! Aah! Hussss!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_DOLPHINPOOL_DESC: A great family attraction! These beautiful creatures will thrill and surprise your guests as they perform amazing stunts!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_ELECTRICIAN_DESC: The Electrician will maintain and repair your electrical equipment. Pretty useful!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_ELECTRICIANHUT_DESC: Allows you to send out electricians to deal with your buildings' power failures. Keep this building out of the way as it's a bit of an eyesore.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_ENTERTAINERSSUITE_DESC: The Entertainers' Office will allow you to hire bigger and better entertainment staff in some of your shows. You can also hire wandering performers here to keep families entertained.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_FASTFOOD_DESC: Supplies burgers, fries and other trashy food. Very popular with visitors on a tight budget - and kids of course!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_FEMALERESTROOM_DESC: This is the Ladies Restroom. Very handy for when nature calls, but also a good place to chat and fix one's face, if necessary.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_FIRSTAIDSTATION_DESC: This Building reassures your guests that you are managing a responsible operation. It also allows you to run some of the more physical activities.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_FLOWERBED2X2_DESC: A medium sized Flowerbed, packed with pretty flowers!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_FLOWERBED3X3_DESC: A monster sized Flowerbed chock full of pretty flowers.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_FOUNTAIN_DESC: Fountains are not only pretty: your guests will appreciate relaxing near the soothing sound of running water.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_GARDENERHUT_DESC: Allows you to hire a gardener to tend the plants.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_GREEK_INTERIORCOLUMN_DE: A classic Greek column, capped with beautiful flowers.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_GREEK_STATUE_DESC: Strategically placed Statues and Sculptures will enhance and beautify the surrounding area.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_GREEK_TREE_DESC: A smashing little tree that will spruce up any casino interior.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_GYM_DESC: Popular with the fitter guests - or with those wishing to get that way! Attract more exclusive guests with the addition of a Personal Trainer.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_HAIRSALON_DESC: Ladies: get the latest hairstyles and colors from our internationally acclaimed stylists!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_HEADOFFICE_DESC: The Head Office will open up many new avenues for development. Once built, check out the Upgrades Menu to choose which directions to take.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_HEALTHSPA_DESC: A nice, relaxing activity; women will especially enjoy using the Health Spa. Attract more exclusive guests with the addition of a world-class masseuse.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_HELIPAD_DESC: The Helipad will allow VERY rich guests to visit. Be careful where you place this, as it can be awfully noisy!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_HOSPITALITYSUITE_DESC: Hire Hosts and Hostesses to look after your most important guests. Direct the staff to watch over your exclusive tables.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_INTERIORBAR_DESC: The Bar allows your guests to get a drink without interrupting their gambling flow. You can even hire waitresses to stop them having to leave the tables!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_INTERIORSTAIRS_DESC: Place stairs to allow access between different levels in your Casino. Strategically placed stairs can be used to guide people to areas of your choosing.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_INTMECHANIC_DESC: Mechanics will be called on to maintain buildings and tables as they break down. Although you will want to keep them out of the way (as they're a bit ugly and smelly), don't force the repair staff to walk too far!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_JANITORCLOSET_DESC: The Cleaner's Closet allows you to hire staff to clean up the mess your guests leave behind. It isn't the sweetest smelling building, so keep it hidden.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_JAPAN_GATEWAY_DESC: This beautifully carved replica gateway will enhance any walkway or entrance.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_JEWELRYSTORE_DESC: This exclusive jewelry will appeal to your richer guest, especially the women and the single guys and girls.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_KENO_DESC: Match the numbers and win an awesome cash prize! This tends to draw in women, especially those of a 'certain age'.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_KENOLOUNGE_DESC: Match the numbers and win an awesome cash prize! This tends to draw in women, especially the more mature ones.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_KITCHEN_DESC: The Chef in the Kitchen will supply your Buffets with food.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_LAMP_DESC: Lights will illuminate the way for your guests during the night. Use the various colors to create a mood, or simply brighten the place up.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_LANDSCAPING_DESC: This office gives you access to the larger interior ornaments.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_LARGECASINO_DESC: The large Casino gives you an enormous floor-space to fill with gambling attractions and other goodies. You can afford to build segregated areas to appeal to each of the guest types and keep the undesirable but necessary buildings out of sight.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_LARGEHOTEL_DESC: This is the flagship of your complex. Although it takes up a lot of space and is rather expensive, the rewards are just as large. With the addition of the High Roller Suites, this place will satisfy the richest of guests.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_LEAFTREE_DESC: These small-leaved trees add a natural feel to any ornamental area.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_LETITRIDE_DESC: Let It Ride is an exciting new variant on Poker that has a strong following among younger gamblers.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_LIVEMUSICVENUE_DESC: This is a great venue for smaller bands. Choose your performers to suit different audiences. Remember to hire an act once you have built this auditorium.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_LOUNGER_DESC: The Sun Lounger gives a more comfortable resting stop than the benches, making them rather popular, but the more prim and proper guests will still prefer to sit bolt upright!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_MAGICSHOP_DESC: A magic shop will appeal to the younger chaps. Fascinating stuff goes on in here.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_MAGICSHOW_DESC: A perennial classic in Vegas, the city of magic and thrills; an astonishing Magic Show for all the family!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_MALERESTROOM_DESC: The Male Restroom is a necessity that you will want to keep in the background. Even well-maintained ones will tend to leave a slight odor in the air!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_MECHANICDEPT_DESC: The Mechanics' Department can house up to three repair staff. Great for areas needing intense maintenance, though they can get a little noisy from time to time.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_MECHANICHUT_DESC: The Mechanic's Hut allows you to hire a single mechanic. As these are so small they can fit almost anywhere, though mechanics are not renowned for keeping the noise down.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_MEDIUMCASINO_DESC: The Medium Casino gives you enough floor-space to build an impressive layout, allowing you to cater for most tastes.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_MEDIUMHOTEL_DESC: The Medium Hotel is a great halfway house, catering to a great many people's needs, and at a reasonable rate. Although it's not as opulent as the Large Hotel, it's a giant step up from the small one!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_MENSCLOTHING_DESC: This Clothing Store stocks designer suits and fashionable casual wear, making it popular with the well-to-do gents.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_MONITOR_STATION_DESC: The Monitor Station allows you to hire up to three Security Guards to patrol your casino. Position these staff members near tables where you believe cheats are operating in order to keep an eye on them.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_MUSEUM_DESC: Get out of the mayhem of Vegas for a while and reflect on history. The museum is sure to attract the more refined visitor to your Lot.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_NIGHTCLUB_DESC: A Nightclub designed for the younger market.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_NIGHTCLUB1_DESC: A pretty cheesy club that pumps out sounds and has a dance floor, but not much more.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_NIGHTCLUB2_DESC: This is a pretty good all-round club. A good sound system and layout offers a great night for most customers.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_NIGHTCLUB3_DESC: The Ballroom gives your older guests a chance to dance the night away at a more relaxed pace. It also has a certain draw for the newly weds.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_NIGHTCLUB4_DESC: The most opulent Nightclub. Some folk will feel uncomfortable here - it's really designed for the most exclusive clientele.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_OBSERVATIONDECK_DESC: The Observation Deck gives your guests the chance to see the Strip in all its glory. Always popular with a large variety of guests, this is a must-have for any well built complex.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_PAIGOW_DESC: Poker, with a hint of the Orient!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_PALM_DESC: Palm Trees offer a welcome break in the desert scenery and produce a restful canopy of shade over walkways and seating areas.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_PALMROW_DESC: A row of beautiful palm trees, neatly spaced and easy to plant.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_PATHGRASS_DESC: Grass areas help to bring life to the barren desert earth.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_PATHSTANDARD_DESC: Standard Paving allows your guests to walk from place to place.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_PATHTARMAC_DESC: Tarmac will let your guests move around, but it looks a little cheap. Given the choice, guests will tend to walk around it. Use this feature to keep them away from more undesirable maintenance areas.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_PATHTHEMED_DESC: Although it is expensive, Themed Paving adds the finishing touch to a well designed lot. People appreciate it when a place is built with the best materials!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_PATHWATER_DESC: Laying down areas of water will make for a more pleasant overall feel.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_PAWNBROKER_DESC: The Pawn Broker lets your guests trade up their possessions for more gambling cash! Be warned though, some of the richer guests will not like to be reminded of the possibility of losing all of their money!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_PITBOSS_DESC: As well as making new tables available, the Pit Supervisor Staff can be located to 'comp' your higher spending guests.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_POTFLOWER1X1_DESC: Pretty flowers in a small pot.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_POTFLOWER2X2_DESC: Pretty flowers in a medium sized pot.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_POTFLOWER3X3_DESC: Lots of pretty flowers in a large pot.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_POWERGENERATOR_DESC: By supplying your own power you will reduce your running costs dramatically. Keep in a secluded area where the noise will not affect your guests.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_POWERSUBSTATION_DESC: By supplying your own power you will reduce your running costs dramatically. Keep in a secluded area where the noise will not affect your guests.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_PROGRESSIVESLOTS_DESC: Progressive Slots hold back small winnings to build up a running Jackpot payout for the whole group. The promise of this big win makes them appealing to the more casual gamer.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_RECYCLINGCENTER_DESC: The Cleaner's Department allows you to hire up to three cleaners, a potent force in the fight against grime.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_RESTAURANT_DESC: The Restaurant supplies good food and appeals to a wide range of guests. Adding waitresses will further enhance their dining experience, and accompanying music will also refine its appeal.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_ROLLERCOASTER_DESC: The ultimate thrill! The Roller Coaster delivers a fast and furious, gut-wrenching, stomach-churning ride. Not for the faint of heart.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_ROULETTE_DESC: Roulette is the classic game of chance with a wealth of betting opportunities. It appeals to a wide range of guests, making it a must for any casino.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_SECURITY_DESC: The Security Office allows you to hire a single Security Guard. Position this staff member near tables where you believe cheats are operating in order to keep an eye on them.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_SHARKPOOL_DESC: Like the Dolphin Pool, but more hardcore: the Shark Pool delivers an aquatic show that will thrill your guests, especially the guys!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_SHOWGIRLS_DESC: Great entertainment for the older, male members of the family.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_SIGN_DESC: The classic Vegas advertising tool. The bigger the sign the more people you'll attract to your Lot!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_SLOT_DESC: Classic Slots have a broad appeal, but the deafening noise can interfere with quieter gambling pastimes.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_SMALLCASINO_DESC: The Small Casino gives you a manageable area to fill with gambling attractions. As it is so small you may want to focus on satisfying certain groups of people, rather than trying to appeal to the masses.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_SMALLHOTEL_DESC: The Small Hotel will be fine for your less well-off guests. Others may make do with this kind of Hotel if nothing else is available.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_SOFA_DESC: Your more discerning guests will surely appreciate a nice soft place to rest. Mmmm...
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_SOUVENIRSHOP_DESC: The Souvenir Shop stocks cheap ornaments to remember the place by. Ideal gifts!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_SPORTSBOOKBETTING_DESC: The Sports Book Lounge allows your guests to bet on live sports! Initially you can show horse racing, but you can upgrade your license to cover other sports too. This is an expensive business, but as the stakes can be enormous, you stand to make a killing!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_STAGESHOW_DESC: Upgrading to one of the shows to provide great entertainment for a wide range of guests.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_STATUE_DESC: Strategically placed Statues and Sculptures will enhance and beautify the surrounding area.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_SWIMMINGPOOL_DESC: There's nothing better than a nice refreshing swim. A great family activity.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_TEXASHOLDEM_DESC: Straight Poker, with a Texan twist!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_THEATRE_DESC: For a more culturally refined show, the Theater delivers on all counts. Hiring a Broadway Cast will greatly increase its appeal.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_THEMEDRIDE_DESC: The Themed Ride is great for the kids and family. Expect lots of noise as your guests are spun every which way!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_TOPLESSREVUE_DESC: Great entertaiment for all lovers of silicone! Adding Lap Dancing to the proceedings will increase its appeal for some, but not everyone will appreciate this.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_TRAVELAGENT_DESC: The Travel Agent lets your guests book up their next visit.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_TREE_DESC: Add trees to any area, and it takes on a more organic, soothing atmosphere.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_VIDEOKENO_DESC: It's like a private Keno Lounge, but on a little screen. Pick your numbers and try to win big!
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_VIDEOPOKER_DESC: For those that prefer to play against a machine, Video Poker is the perfect answer.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_WATERPLANT_DESC: As your water use increases, it may be a good idea to build your own Water Treatment Plant to cut down on your water charges.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_WAVEPOOL_DESC: Bored with splashing about in still waters? The Wave Pool is a dream come true. Riding on the crest of a wave in the middle of the desert! Does it get more decadent than that?
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_WEDDINGCHAPEL_DESC: Vegas is fast becoming the Wedding Capital of the World. Join the wedding production line, and think about hiring an Elvis impersonator to add the icing to the cake.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_WHEELOFFORTUNE_DESC: Pick a number and spin the wheel! Not for the discerning gambler, but fun for the tourists.
ID_BUILDING_TYPE_WOMENSCLOTHING_DESC: This store stocks the latest designer dresses and suits. Some smart outfits for some smart ladies!
ID_BUILDSALEEND_DESC: That's it for Max Delaney's cement sale! He hopes you made the most of his generosity!
ID_BUILDSALESTART_DESC: Crazy Max Delaney's Construction Company has slashed the cost of cement for the next day! All building costs are reduced by 50% for the next twenty-four hours!

ID_POWERINCREASE_DESC: Because of damage to the local power station, the Nevada Electricity Company has had to increase the price of their output for the foreseeable future. If you're smart, you can get around this with some judicious building...
ID_PUMPDAMAGE_DESC: Low quality materials from a shifty supplier have led to all beer pumps in bars across the Strip breaking down! Get your mechanics out to fix yours as quickly as you can!
ID_QUAKE_DESC: It's an earthquake, baby! That means your guests are going to be racing for the airport to get the heck out of the Strip. Expect business to quieten down for a little while. Not only that, but all buildings on the Strip have had there health knocked right down and will need to be repaired as quickly as possible! Man, is there anything good about earthquakes?
ID_RATATTACK_DESC: A plague of rats has swept into the Strip; your hotels and food outlets immediately get knocked down to 10% health. You'll need to use mechanics to repair these buildings!
ID_SANDBOX_CIRCUSCIRCUSDRIVE_DESC:
Circus Circus Drive and Karen Avenue feed The Strip. There are some back street lots, away from the main road that are priced most reasonably.

Lots marked Red are for sale. Blue ones are established casino complexes.
ID_SANDBOX_CONVENTIONCENTERDRIVE_DESC:
This location consists of some deep but narrow Lots. Buying both of the Lots north of Convention Center Drive and merging them will create a good sized area to play with. The Convention Center to the east will deliver visiting guests right into your lap!

Lots marked Red are for sale. Blue ones are established casino complexes.
ID_SANDBOX_DESERTINNROAD_DESC:
The stretch of The Strip benefits from guest arriving at the Convention Center, though the Country Club to the south may pose a slight challenge.

Lots marked Red are for sale. Blue ones are established casino complexes.
ID_SANDBOX_FLAMINGOROAD_DESC:
Here, the world famous Flamingo Road slices across the Strip creating a diverse series of Lots - which range from tiny to enormous - and giving you the opportunity to start small but ultimately build up to owning some prestigious real estate!

Lots marked Red are for sale. Blue ones are established casino complexes.
ID_SANDBOX_HACIENDAAVENUE_DESC:
At the southern most end of the Strip is Hacienda Avenue. On offer are the most diverse set of Lots available on the entire Strip. Being so far south will mean that you will have to work harder to draw people away from the more central areas.

Lots marked Red are for sale. Blue ones are established casino complexes.
ID_SANDBOX_HARMONAVENUE_DESC:
The Harmon Avenue junction will give you a challenge. The available Lots are deep but thin, and a large established casino complex will draw customers away from your fledgling empire.

Lots marked Red are for sale. Blue ones are established casino complexes.
ID_SANDBOX_RUEDEMONTECARLO_DESC:
Rue De Monte Carlo and Tompkins Avenue collide here creating a minor crossroads with The Strip. Care will need to be taken to maximize use of space on the narrowest lots!

Lots marked Red are for sale. Blue ones are established casino complexes.
ID_SANDBOX_SAHARAAVENUE_DESC:
Here West and East Sahara Avenues intersect the Strip where they create a very busy location. A good selection of Lots are for sale, ranging from small to medium in size and price.

Lots marked Red are for sale. Blue ones are established casino complexes.
ID_SANDBOX_SANDSAVENUE_DESC:
Spring Mountain Road and Sands Avenue meet along this stretch of the Strip. You have a good range of Lot sizes to choose from, ranging from compact to pretty expansive.

Lots marked Red are for sale. Blue ones are established casino complexes.
ID_SANDBOX_STLOUISAVENUE_DESC:
The most northerly location for development, the St Louis Avenue area offers a large Lot being sold off as two independent ones and a couple of smaller, cheaper Lots, ideal for those wanting to start small and grow their empire.

Lots marked Red are for sale. Blue ones are established casino complexes.
ID_SANDBOX_TROPICANAAVENUE_DESC:
Tropicana Avenue slices across the Strip, linking Interstate 15 to the west with McCarran International Airport to the east, making this a busy part of town. 

Lots marked Red are for sale. Blue ones are established casino complexes.
ID_SANDBOX_WESTCHESTERDRIVE_DESC:
Westchester Drive may be a comparatively small road, but the Lots around it are some of the largest in town! There's potential here for a building masterpiece, I'm sure.

Lots marked Red are for sale. Blue ones are established casino complexes.
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_AGENT_HERE_DESC: Secret Agent, Commander Nathan Kane has arrived in town! Click the button below to find out where he is and what he's doing!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_AGENT_LOSE_DESC: He hasn't had a great time: no super-villains to be defeated, no secret bases to be blown up. There's nothing you could have done about that of course, but maybe you could have built more to keep him diverted? He's decided that he won't be back any time soon, and Her Majesty's Secret Service is going to hang onto that $8,000 for the time being. Tough luck!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_AGENT_WARNING_DESC:
Keep it under your hat, but the word is that Great Britain's foremost gentleman spy Commander Nathan Kane is on his way to Las Vegas in nine hours time, having been tipped off about some dastardly plan or other. He's infamous for his expensive tastes, and is also prone to getting into fights with Russian assassins, so expect some damage to your buildings!

While he's here, he's going to be in the mood for half-naked honeys, cocktails (shaken, not stirred), high quality cuisine, high-end nightclubs, and massages. He also has a penchant for Baccarat, and will need the services of a personal trainer (preferably female).

Make him happy, and Her Majesty's Secret Service will happily reimburse you to the tune of $8,000 for your trouble! Cool!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_AGENT_WIN_DESC:
He had a great time, and also found time to stop a super-villain's plan to destroy America with his revolutionary 'laser' gun! By way of thanks, here's a check for $8,000 personally signed by the Queen of England herself. How about that?

Nathan Kane will return!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BEAUTYCONTEST_DESC:
It's time for the Miss Desert Sun Beauty Contest! A dozen beautiful ladies from all over the country will come and look radiant for a panel of washed-up celebrities, but only one can walk away with the world-famous tiara, sash and tiny trumpet! This event will be here in 24 hours, and you've got a shot at staging it! To win this prestigious show onto your property you'll need to build an Arena, and all of the business types that the fans will be looking for. The following people are going to be eagerly awaiting the contest:

  Hardcore Gamblers
  Businessmen
  Male Parents
  Single Guys

You're going to need to get the highest reputation with these people types if you want to win the event to your Lot. If you succeed in doing so, the event organizers will pay you $10,000! Good luck!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BEAUTYCONTESTLOSE_ARENA_: Well, you didn't build an Arena by the time of the contest's deadline, so the organizers of Miss Desert Sun have decided to take their event somewhere else. Unlucky!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BEAUTYCONTESTLOSE_FANS_D: Well, you failed to convince the organizers of the Miss Desert Sun beauty contest that yours was the right Lot for their event. This means you've missed out on a lot of business, and of course that fat $10,000 paycheck. Bad luck!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BEAUTYCONTESTOVER_DESC: The winner of this year's Miss Desert Sun was Miss Texas, a former spot welder from Tomball. She loves children, those cute monkeys with the white faces, and drinking Tequila till it comes out of her nose. Ain't she a cutie?
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BEAUTYCONTESTWIN_DESC: Excellent work; you've managed to convince the organizers of the Miss Desert Sun contest to bring the event to your entertainment complex. That means a nice fat payout of $10,000 for your bank account!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BOXINGMATCH_DESC:
Big news: the boxing match of the Century - 'The Mighty' Samson Stone vs. Big Johnny Cage - is coming to Las Vegas in 24 hours, and you've got a shot at staging it! To win this prestigious event onto your property you'll need to build an Arena, and all of the business types that the boxing fans are looking for. The following people are going to be on the lookout for boxing:

  Businessmen
  Hardcore Gamblers
  Male Parents
  Single Guys
  Retired Men
  Sad Drunks
  Bikers
  Biker Babes\ Male High Rollers
 Boxers (Samson Stone and Johnny Cage)

You're going to need to get the highest reputation with these people types if you want to win the event to your Lot. Good luck!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BOXINGMATCHLOSE_ARENA_DE:
You didn't build an Arena before the deadline, so the event organizers have had to take the BOXING MATCH OF THE CENTURY somewhere else.

Ah, well.
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BOXINGMATCHLOSE_FANS_DES: Shame! You didn't do enough to make the fight fans happy, so the event organizers have opted to take the match somewhere else. Unlucky, kid!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BOXINGMATCHSHOWOVER_DESC: Bang! Johnny Cage is out for the count! Uproar! Wow, that was some bout. You should've seen it, man, it was freakin' spectacular!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BOXINGMATCHWIN_DESC: Excellent! You've succeeded in getting the fight of the Century to come your complex! Expect hordes of fight fans to swamp to your property, looking for some action!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BOYBAND_DESC:
Boy band GAZE (that's Gerard, Adrian, Zach, Eddie) are coming to town in forty-eight hours time, and they're looking for somewhere to play their next big gig. If you want to get GAZE to play at your complex, you'll need to build an Arena, as well as all of the business and facility types the GAZE fans are looking for. People who'll want to see GAZE are as follows:

  Female Parents
  Female Children
  Single Girls
  Hen Party Guests

If you manage to get the boy band to play at your entertainment complex, they'll act as a massive draw to the people types listed above, and their presence will guarantee you make mucho moolah!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BOYBANDLOSE_ARENA_DESC: Because you failed to build an Arena by the deadline, GAZE management has decided to take the show to another town. Bye then!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BOYBANDLOSE_FANS_DESC: Unlucky: GAZE's management are of the opinion that your entertainment complex isn't 'exciting' enough for their act to play there. This is probably because you didn't get enough Gaze fans onto your Lot, to be honest. But never mind: there'll be other big events for you to play for!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BOYBANDSHOWOVER_DESC: Move along, nothing to see. GAZE have wound up their performance and everyone who went to see them had a tremendous time. Man, talk about easily pleased...
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_BOYBANDWIN_DESC: Excellent work: GAZE's management have decided to bring the show to your complex! Get ready to be swamped by teenage girls, mothers and single women!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_COUNTESS_HERE_DESC: Countess Adora Laroche has arrived on the Strip. Click the button below to find out where she is and what she's doing!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_COUNTESS_LOSE_DESC: Adora Laroche described her experience as 'pitiful'. Don't let it bother you too much, she's like that with everyone. This does mean you've missed out on all that cash though. Oh well, easy come, easy go!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_COUNTESS_WARNING_DESC:
...although she wouldn't be happy to hear herself referred to as a 'whale'. Regardless, the Countess Adora Laroche is coming to town in seven hours time to do a little shopping and generally live it up. While she's here, she'll be looking for clothes, jewelry, cocktails, a rare masterpiece or two and somewhere she can be made to look even more radiant than she already is. Oh, she'll also need somewhere to stay of course, and she's unlikely to settle for anything less than the biggest and the best.

If you make her happy while she's on your property, she'll send you a gift worth $10,000! How about that?
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_COUNTESS_WIN_DESC: She described the service she found there as 'more than adequate', quite a compliment from the ravishing Ms. Laroche. She's rewarded you with a $10,000 check, pretty snazzy!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_COUNTRYSINGER_HERE_DESC: The world's best loved Country Music star is here in Las Vegas; are you ready for him? Click the link below to find out where he is and what he's doing!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_COUNTRYSINGER_LOSE_DESC: He didn't really enjoy himself. He was looking for something a little wilder! I'm afraid to say that he's going to hold on to that $3,000 for the time being; unlucky!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_COUNTRYSINGER_WARNING_DE:
Country legend Mason Jeffries is coming to Vegas to perform a gig! While he's in town, he'll be looking to relax and have a little fun, so he'll probably be after a little country music, booze and fast food. He also has a taste for Texas Hold 'Em, and of course you'll need to build him somewhere he can stay. Nothing too fancy though, he doesn't want to ruin his 'down-home' image.

He'll be in town in four hours time and if he stays on your property he'll draw country music fans to the Lot in droves. If you make him happy, he'll tip you $3,000!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_COUNTRYSINGER_WIN_DESC: He had a terrific time! He had so much fun, in fact, that he's decided to chuck $3,000 your way. Pretty sweet!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_DANDYRIVERS_HERE_DESC: Mr. Dandy Rivers has come to town. Is your shopping complex ready for him? Her? Click the link below to find out where he is and what he's up to!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_DANDYRIVERS_LOSE_DESC: Oh dear. Mr. Rivers has not had a tremendous time in Las Vegas, and has decided to leave. Next time, he's going to take himself off to Paris! No $8,000 bonus for you, sadly.
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_DANDYRIVERS_WARNING_DESC:
Dandy Rivers (Female impersonator, stand-up comic and star of hit sitcom 'Just Dandy!') is coming to town in six hours time for a big show. Make him/her happy, and he'll tip you to the tune of $8,000! While he's here, he'll be looking for men and women's clothing, expensive drinks, pricey meals, somewhere to have a boogie and, of course, somewhere to stay. He also has a passion for the performing arts, so bear this in mind when you're trying to please him.

Best of luck!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_DANDYRIVERS_WIN_DESC: Dandy says: 'What a marvelous time I've had at your entertainment complex! You've really made my day. By way of thank you, here's a signed photo of my good self. Oh, and $8,000. Don't spend it all at once, honey!' Wow, what a swell gal! Um.
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_FASHIONSHOW_DESC:
Major fashion label Sweeet Thing wants to launch their new range in Vegas with a huge show! Great! To ensure that you get this big event (which comes to town in thirty-six hours time) to your property, you'll need to build an Arena and all of the business types that fashion-lovers will be after. Fashion-lovers are these folk right here:

  Businesswomen
  Single Girls
  Female High Rollers

Succeed here, and the event organizers will pay you off to the tune of $30,000! Pretty 'Sweeet', I think you'll agree.
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_FASHIONSHOWLOSE_FANS_DES: Unlucky: you didn't convince Sweeet Thing that your complex was right for their show, so they've decided to take it somewhere else. No $30,000 payment for you now!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_FASHIONSHOWWIN_DESC: Good work; you've managed to convince Sweeet Thing that your Lot is the right venue for their big show! Great job, here's $30,000 by way of payment!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_GOLFER_HERE_DESC: Danny Jackson has flown into town. Are you ready for the Swingmaster General? Click the link below to find out where he is and what he's doing!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_GOLFER_LOSE_DESC: Hmm, it doesn't look like Mr. Jackson had the best time when he visited your entertainment complex. It's doubtful that he'll be giving you the $8,000 that was promised, and your Lot's reputation hasn't improved much either. Shame!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_GOLFER_WARNING_DESC:
Professional golfer Danny 'Swingmaster General' Jackson is coming to town in six hours! He's got plenty of time to kill between tournaments and is absolutely loaded. While he's here he's going to be on the lookout for soft drinks, somewhere he can work out, and movies. He's also well-known for having a taste for Sports Book betting, and will no doubt need somewhere to swim and somewhere nice to sleep.

Make him happy at your complex, and he'll tip you $8,000, as well as increasing the reputation of that particular Lot by 20 points!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_GOLFER_WIN_DESC: Well, alright! Mr. Jackson on the Strip, and it's largely thanks to you! Here's a signed golf bag by way of congratulations, and it's stuffed with cash (looks like about $8,000)! Your Lot's reputation has leapt up by 20 points!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_HALLEBERRY_HERE_DESC: Hollywood starlet Tia Jackson has dropped into Las Vegas! Are you ready for her? Click the link below to find out where she is and what she's doing!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_HALLEBERRY_LOSE_DESC: She didn't really enjoy herself at all on your property, and won't be giving you that $5,000 now. Shame!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_HALLEBERRY_WARNING_DESC:
Miss Tia Jackson is on her way! She's the toast of Hollywood, star of such blockbusters as 'The Fire Within', 'New York Nights' and 'The Shadow King', and she's coming to Las Vegas in six hours with plenty of time to kill and a lot of money to spend! She's in the mood for doing some clothes shopping, buying some very expensive jewelry, making herself as pretty as can be and then having a big night out. She'll also be on the lookout for any kind of gambling you care to throw her way, and of course she'll need somewhere nice to stay.

Make her happy, and she'll tip you $5,000! Get to it, kid!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_HALLEBERRY_WIN_DESC: Miss Jackson had a sweet time, and she's going to tell her friends back in LA all about your fantastic leisure complex! By way of showing her appreciation, here's $5,000! Good job!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_HAMDRAKE_HERE_DESC: Hamilton Drake is in town, with a load of money burning a hole in his wallet. Do what you can to relieve him of his cash!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_HAMDRAKE_LOSE_DESC: Hamilton Drake is out of here, having had a miserable time. He's going to head back to Hollywood, where they REALLY know how to treat their stars! Bad luck!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_HAMDRAKE_WARNING_DESC:
Star of Sci-Fi hit 'Eye of Uranus' Hamilton Drake is coming to Las Vegas in three hours time! Very rich, with very expensive tastes; Drake is looking to spend his cash on clothes, working out, plenty of hardcore relaxation and any kind of gambling you care to throw his way. 

Make him happy during his time here and he'll tip you $2,500!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_HAMDRAKE_WIN_DESC: He described his experience as 'out of this world'! What a chump. Still, here's $2,500 of his cash - spend it wisely!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_JDEVLIN_HERE_DESC: Joel Devlin has arrived; make sure you get him onto your property! Click the link below to find out where he is and what he's up to!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_JDEVLIN_LOSE_DESC: Wow. He had a pretty bleak time all in all, and wasn't at all happy with any of the services your complex offered. You're unlikely to be getting that tip off him now ($9,000! down the drain, man!), and he's not sure if he'll be back. Tough break!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_JDEVLIN_WARNING_DESC:
He's probably the world's most famous man, crown prince of Eighties pop Joel Devlin, and he'll be in town in eight hours time! He's got lots of money and plenty of time to kill. Get him into your entertainment complex and many of his fans will follow! If you make him happy, he'll also send you $9,000 to show his gratitude! To make him happy, you'll have to offer at least some of the following:

  Themed Rides
  Arcades
  Soda Bars
  Fast Food Restaurants
  Magic Shows
  Magic Shops
  Medium Hotels
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_JDEVLIN_WIN_DESC: He had a fantastic time and will no doubt be back for more! Great work, man! And hey, here's your $9,000. Cool!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_JDEVLIN_WIN_NAME: Mr. Devlin is leaving Sin City!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_OBJ_AGENT_DESC:
Keep it under your hat, but the word is that Great Britain's foremost gentleman spy Commander Nathan Kane is on his way to Las Vegas, having been tipped off about some dastardly plan or other. He's infamous for his expensive tastes, and is also prone to getting into fights with Russian assassins, so expect some damage to your buildings! Here are some of the things he'll be looking for when he hits the Strip:

  Topless Revues
  Cocktail Bars (with Waitresses)
  A la Carte Restaurants
  Exclusive Nightclubs
  Masseuses
  Personal Trainers
  Baccarat Tables
  Medium Hotels

Keep him happy and Her Majesty's Secret Service will happily reimburse you to the tune of $8,000 for your trouble!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_OBJ_COUNTESS_DESC:
The Countess Adora Laroche is coming to town in seven hours time to do a little shopping and generally live it up! Here's what she's after:

  Women's Clothing
  Jewelry Stores
  Cocktails
  Art Museums
  Beauty Parlors
  High Roller Suites

If you make her happy on your property, she'll send you a gift worth $10,000!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_OBJ_COUNTRYSINGER_DESC:
Country legend Mason Jeffries is coming to Vegas to perform a gig! While he's in town, he'll be looking for the following:

  Country Music
  Bars
  Texas Hold 'Em
  Small Hotels
  Fast Food 

He'll be in town in four hours time and if he stays on your property he'll draw country music fans to the Lot in droves. If you make him happy, he'll tip you $3,000!
ID_SANDBOXEVENT_OBJ_DANDYRIVERS_DESC:
Dandy Rivers (Female impersonator, stand-up comic and star of hit sitcom 'Just Dandy!') is coming to town in six hours time for a big show. Make him/her happy, and he'll tip you to the tune of $8,000! While he's here, he'll be looking for some of the following:

  Women's Clothing
  Men's Clothing
  Cocktails
  Theaters
  Discos
  Medium Hotels
