ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER1WARNING1_DESC: You've got 1,000 people to visit your property! Keep it up!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER1WARNING2_DESC: You've got 2,000 visitors to your property! Not long to go!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER1WARNING3_DESC: Get 50 more visitors to your property, and you've won the scenario!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER1WON_DESC: You've succeeded in building the most attractive family entertainment complex! That's this scenario completed, well done!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER2HOTEL_DESC: Damien G. West has responded to the construction of your Hotel by building a large one of his own! He's out for blood, baby; stay cool!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER2PRICECHANGE_DESC: He's reduced all his prices by 40%. Everything must go!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER2PRICECHANGE_NAME: Damien G. West's lowered his prices!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER2PRICEDROP_DESC: In response to you building activity feature on your Lot, Damien G. West has cut the prices of all his activity features! He's started to fight dirty!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER2RIDE_DESC: Quick as a flash, Damien G. West has responded to your construction of a Themed Ride by building one of his own. Only, as far as he's concerned, his is BIGGER and BETTER!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER2WARNING1_DESC: He's got 1,000 guests to visit his Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER2WARNING1_NAME: Damien G. West is doing pretty well...
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER2WARNING2_DESC: He's managed to get 2,000 visitors to his property! Not long to go before he's won the scenario!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER2WARNING2_NAME: Damien West is doing very well...
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER2WARNING3_DESC: Damien G. West is only 50 guests away from winning this scenario...
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER2WON_DESC: Bad luck, movie mogul Damien G. West has beaten you to the prize. Maybe you weren't ambitious enough?
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER2WON_NAME: Damien G. West has won this scenario
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER3PRICECHANGE_DESC: She's dropped them by 20%. Looks like she's determined to win this one!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER3RIDEPRICEDROP_DES: Chase Lanyon has dropped the price of her Themed Ride to make it more attractive to her visitors!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER3WARNING1_DESC: She's successfully got 1,000 visitors onto her property!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER3WARNING2_DESC: She's got 2,000 visitors to visit her property!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER3WARNING3_DESC: 50 more visitors on her property, and Chase Lanyon will have won the scenario!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER3WON_DESC: Unlucky! Racing driver Chase Lanyon crossed the finish line ahead of you. Maybe you were too slow?
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_PLAYER3WON_NAME: Chase Lanyon has won this scenario
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_POPQUEEN_DESC: Miss Samantha Banks is here! Click the link below to find out where she is and what she's after!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_POPQUEENLOSE_DESC: She couldn't find anything she was looking for on the Strip, so she's decided that she's going to get out of town. Shame, she had a check for $2,000 in her purse that she was just itching to give away...
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_POPQUEENWARNING_DESC:
Samantha Banks is in town for a few days! She's one of the world's biggest performing artistes, loved by millions of young men and women all over the world, and she'll be here in two hours time!

While she's here, she's going to be in the mood for a little physical exercise, clothes shopping, soft drinks, and a little low-stakes, big thrills gambling. She also really digs big, crazy rides, and she's a bit of a sun-worshipper, so maybe some loungers might be in order.

Make her happy and she'll tip you to the tune of $2,000. Go for it, kid!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_POPQUEENWIN_DESC: She's had an awesome time and is delighted with all of the shops and services your complex has offered. She's so happy, she's decided to send you a check for $2,000, along with a signed photo of herself! Wow, you'll be the envy of all your friends. Heck, I'm pretty jealous myself!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_POWERINCREASE_DESC: It was inevitable really; that second earth tremor has caused extensive damage to the local electricity grid. To pay for repairs, the Electricity Company have had to increase the cost of their service. You could offset this cost if you built your own power generator...
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_STARTUPMESSAGE_DESC:
Time to get your shorts and shades on, kiddo; it's Summer Holiday time! Expect a huge influx of people who are after good, clean fun!

In this scenario, you'll need to build the most popular family entertainment complex, so you'll need to do the following:

Become the first player to get 2,000 thrill-seekers to check out their entertainment complex. A 'thrill-seeker' is any one of these guys:

  Female Parents 
  Male Parents
  Boys
  Girls
  Single Girls
  Single Guys
  Skater Dudes
  Skater chicks

Make $1,000 profit from your activity sales by the end of Day Five

Build a Roller Coaster by the end of Day Nine

You'll be up against two opponents: Ms Chase Lanyon, the fast moving but reckless lady racer, and Damien G. West, loony billionaire movie director!

Stay cool!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_SWIMEXPOSE_DESC: If you can make 150 Pool Pass sales by the end of Day Three, you'll receive a $1,000 bonus from your refreshed patrons!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_SWIMEXPOSE_NAME: Hot time, summer in the City!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_SWIMFAIL_DESC: You've failed to get 150 swimmers into the water, so no bonus for you. Never mind!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_SWIMWIN_DESC: You've got 150 visitors to your swimming pool! Everyone's had a wonderful time, and you've received a tasty $1,000 bonus for your troubles. Good work!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_TREMOR_DESC: Boom! The Strip is hit by the biggest tremor in twenty years. Buildings damaged, people shaken up; it's a freaking disaster! You'll need to get your mechanics to repair your buildings as quickly as possible; get to work!
ID_SCENARIO_ASU_TREMOR2_DESC: Earth Tremor 2: The Quake takes Vegas! This one's not as extreme as the last, but your mechanics are still going to have their work cut out getting everything back to peak condition!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_AGENTLOSE_TEXT: From his management crew: 'Mr. Carter's would like it be known that he had a MISERABLE time in Las Vegas, and the promised payment of $6,000 will now not be paid.' Bad luck, man!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_AGENTLOSE_TITLE: Magnus Carter is leaving Las Vegas!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_AGENTSPAWNED_TEXT:
Magnus Carter is in Las Vegas. Make sure you get him to your Lot!

Click the link below to find out where he is and he's up to!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_AGENTWARNING_DESC:
Former 'Mangled Heart' front man and God of Goth Rock Magnus Carter will be on the Strip for a few days. He's here to promote his new tour, but can always find time to kick back with brews and groupies. While he's here he's going to be looking for booze, some particularly exciting activity, video games, somewhere to have a dance, and somewhere to stay. He's also got a thing for sharks...

If you build the things he likes, he might tip you $6,000! Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_AGENTWIN_TEXT: He rocked hard and had a tasty time. By way of gratitude, he's throwing a check for $6,000 your way. Pretty sweet!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_BUILDDISCOUNTEND_DESC: That's it for Max Delaney's building materials sale! He hopes you made the most of his generosity!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_BUILDDISCOUNTSTART_DESC: Crazy Max Delaney's Construction Company is offering discounts on all building materials for the next three days! Construction costs will be dropped by 20% until Day Nine at 8am!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_CHEATLEAVE_TEXT: Thanks to improved security on the Strip, the gang of super-cheats has been arrested!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_CHEATLEAVE_TITLE: Super-Cheats rounded up by local authorities
ID_SCENARIO_BS_CHEATSPAWN_TEXT: Word from the Nevada State Police has it that a pack of twenty super-cheats are targeting all casinos in the area! Tighten security to make sure you don't get ripped off; the police want you to install one security office per casino before Day Four 10am to ensure the cheats get rounded up! There's a reward, you know...
ID_SCENARIO_BS_NVGC_FINED_DESC:
Official report from Nevada Gaming Commission

  Total fine: %d
  Tables with a 'criminal' house edge: %d
ID_SCENARIO_BS_NVGC_NOFINE_DESC: The Nevada Gaming Commission found no cause for complaint with your casino complex, and see no reason to fine you. Good work!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_NVGC_WARNING_DESC: Inspectors from the Nevada State Gaming Commission are coming to town to make sure all casinos are playing fair by their guests. All tables with a 'criminal' house edge (the highest setting) will incur a $600 fine per table. These guys will be here in two hours, so make sure all your tables are ship-shape!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_AGENT_DESC:
Former 'Mangled Heart' front man and God of Goth Rock Magnus Carter will be on the Strip for a few days. He's here to promote his new tour, but can always find time to kick back with brews and groupies. While he's here he's going to be looking for the following:

  Bars
  Themed Rides
  Shark Pools
  Arcades
  Clubbing
  Magic Shops
  Medium or Large Hotels
  Restaurants with Rock

If you build the things he likes, he might tip you $6,000!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_CHEATS_DESC: Word from the Nevada State Police has it that a pack of twenty super-cheats are targeting all casinos in the area! Tighten security to make sure you don't get ripped off; the police want you to install one security office per casino before Day Four 10am to ensure the cheats get rounded up!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_CHEATSGONE_DESC: The gang of cheats has successfully been brought to book. As a reward for your diligence, the Nevada State Police have given you $1,000!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_CHEATSLOSE_DESC: You didn't install enough security in your casinos, so the cheating scumbags got away scott-free. The Nevada State Police are a little annoyed to have let these guys slip through their fingers and won't be giving you that reward now. Shame, man!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_CUSP_DESC:
At 12pm today, moral pressure group the Coalition of United States Parents will arrive in Vegas! They're here to force the closure of the less reputable businesses in the region, and they'll try and achieve this by walking around any Lots featuring these business types and bothering the guests. Here are the businesses they're going to be targeting:

  Clubs with pole dancers
  Nightclub with pole dancers
  Exclusive Nightclubs
  Topless Revues
  Showgirls

Any businesses of this type are going to find their reputation falling as long as CUSP are in town!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_CUSP_NOPORN_DESC: CUSP has found nothing to gripe about on your property, and see no reason to harass any of your customers. Nice work!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_CUSP_PORN_DESC: CUSP has aggressively persuaded visitors to your property to avoid your seedier establishments. These will have had their reputations damaged, and won't be getting any business for a while. Unlucky!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_LARGEHOTEL_DESC: This time around, you're going to need to build up a prominent presence on the Strip. To complete this scenario, you'll need to beat this objective: build a Large Hotel by the end of Day Two. Good luck!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_LARGEHOTELDONE_DESC: Well alright! You got your Large Hotel up before the deadline! You're well on your way to beating the scenario. But there's still work to be done; get cracking!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_LARGEHOTELLOSE_DESC: No Large Hotel before the deadline? Sorry to say, but this means that you've lost this objective, and the scenario as a whole. Bad luck, chum!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_MOSTVISITORS_DESC: Here's another objective you'll need to complete if you want to win this scenario: by the end of Day Five, try and make more sales than either of your opponents. You'll stand a better chance of doing this if you build the biggest, brightest Casino complex on the Strip! And remember, your opponents are out to get there first; let them win this objective, and the scenario is lost!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_MOSTVISITORS_NAME: Most sales end of Day Five!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_MOSTVISITORSDONE_DESC: Good work; you've made more sales by the deadline than either of your opponents! Objective complete!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_OILBARON_DESC:
Wealthy oil baron Tex Bannerman will be in town 'real soon'. He's liable to be on the Strip for a couple of days, and in that time he's looking for:

  Lap Dancers
  Pole Dancers
  Beers
  Country Music
  Fast Food
  Masseuses
  Texas Hold 'Em
  High Roller Suites

Make him happy, and he'll tip you $5,000!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_OTHERLOT_DESC: Here's another, slightly tougher objective you'll need to beat if you want to complete this scenario: buy the other available Lot in the world by the end of Day Eight!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_OTHERLOTLOSE_DESC: Bad luck; you failed to buy a second Lot before the deadline. Sorry to say that means you've lost this scenario.
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_OTHERLOTSALES_DESC:
Good work, you've bought a second Lot. Now you have to DO something with it!

Here's a new objective for you to take on: within any one day, make 300 total sales from this second Lot. Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_OTHERLOTSALES_NAME: Make 300 sales from your new Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_OTHERLOTSALESWIN_DESC: Excellent work; you managed to make 300 sales from your second Lot in one day. That's ace, objective completed!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_OTHERLOTWIN_DESC:
Great job, you managed to buy two Lots ahead of the deadline! Well done!

But here's a new objective for you to take on: within any one day, make a total of 300 sales from this second Lot. Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_STATUES_DESC: Build three Statues of any size to earn a $2,000 reward from the Nevada State Planning Department!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_STATUESDONE_DESC: You've built three Statues! The Nevada State Planning Department is delighted with your efforts to improve the Vegas scenery, and have awarded you $2,000! Swish!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_WOFSALES_DESC: Haven't got a Wheel of Fortune yet? Now might be the time to build one; the Nevada Gaming Commission is offering a $500 bonus if you can get twenty gamblers to hit the Wheel within twenty-four hours!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_WOFSALESFAIL_DESC: Well, you didn't manage to get twenty people to gamble on the Wheel of Fortune. Never mind; who needs $500 anyway?
ID_SCENARIO_BS_OBJ_WOFSALESWIN_DESC: You got twenty gamblers to visit your Wheel of Fortune. Pretty good work; here's $500 from the Nevada Gaming Commission to acknowledge your achievement!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_P2MEDIUMHOTEL_DESC: Chase Lanyon has built herself a Medium Hotel. Check it out by clicking the link below!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_P2SMALLCASINO1_DESC: Miss Lanyon's decided to build a Small Casino! Not much room in there, but she's determined to make the most of the space!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_P2SMALLCASINO2_DESC: Miss Lanyon's built herself another Small Casino! It sure is cramped, but she's going to do what she can with it!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_P3LARGEHOTEL_DESC: Derren Languid has always liked the idea of owning his own Large Hotel, and he just loves the Indian look of this one! And you know what? It IS kind of pretty! Click the link below to see for yourself!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_P3MEDIUMCASINO_DESC: Derren Languid liked the architect's plans for the Medium Casino, so he's decided to have one built!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_PLAYER1WON_TEXT: You got the most guests onto your property by the end of Day Five! That's this scenario completed, well done!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_PLAYER2WON_TEXT: Unlucky! Chase Lanyon had the most visitors to her property before the deadline. Unfortunately, this means you've lost the whole scenario.
ID_SCENARIO_BS_PLAYER3WON_TEXT: Unlucky! Derren Languid had the most visitors to his property before the deadline. Unfortunately, this means you've lost the whole scenario.
ID_SCENARIO_BS_PLAYER3WON_TITLE: Mr. Languid got the most visitors!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_PRESSUREGROUPSPAWN_TEXT: The Coalition of United States Parents has arrived in Vegas! Expect trouble!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_PRESSUREGROUPWARNING_TEXT: At 12pm today, moral pressure group the Coalition of United States Parents will arrive in Vegas! They're here to force the closure of the less reputable businesses in the region, and they'll try and achieve this by walking around any Lots featuring these business types and bothering the guests. Expect any topless revue shows, pole dancing venues etc. to have a much harder time finding custom while these guys are in town!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_STAGHEN_DESC: It's their last night of freedom... a huge party of stag and hen night revelers has arrived on the Strip, looking to get drunk, naked and, let's be brutally frank here, downright ugly. Give them what they want, man!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_STARTUPMESSAGE_DESC:
It's time to get big!

This time around, you're going to need to build up a prominent presence on the Strip. To beat this scenario, you'll have to complete three objectives:

First, make a higher number of sales from your Lot than your opponents by the end of Day Five.

Secondly, build a Large Hotel by the end of Day Two. Sounds pretty simple, but these don't come cheap!

And thirdly, buy yourself a second Lot by the end of Day Eight.

In this scenario, you're going to be up against the queen of the racetrack Chase Lanyon and easy-going celebrity photographer Derren Languid. Good luck!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_STATUES_DESC: Build three Statues (any size) and you'll earn a $2,000 reward from the Nevada State Planning Department! Cool!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_WEDDINGFOLK_DESC: Remember that huge party of stag and hen night revelers that showed up in Las Vegas last night? Well, today's their big day! Get on the case, and build plenty of what they're after!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_WHALECOMING_DESC:
Wealthy oil baron Tex Bannerman will be in town 'real soon'. He's liable to be on the Strip for a few days, and in that time he'll no doubt be looking for dancing girls, booze, country music, a little back rubbing, a lot of gambling and of course somewhere up market to stay.

Make him happy, and he may tip you $5,000!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_WHALEHERE_DESC: Tex Bannerman, wealthy oil baron, has arrived in Las Vegas, looking to unwind. Are you ready for this good ol' boy?
ID_SCENARIO_BS_WHALELOSE_TEXT: He's out of here, and he's looking a little angry. Looks like he had a pretty miserable time, and it's unlikely that he'll return. And you've also missed out on the promised $5,000. Tough luck, kiddo!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_WHALELOSE_TITLE: Tex Bannerman is leaving Las Vegas
ID_SCENARIO_BS_WHALESPAWNED_TEXT: Oil baron Tex Bannerman has come to the Strip, and he's looking to have the time of his life! Click the link below to find out where he is on the Strip and what he's doing!
ID_SCENARIO_BS_WHALEWIN_TEXT: He had the time of his life and can't wait to come back! Yee, and indeed, haw.
ID_SCENARIO_BS_WOFSALES_DESC: Haven't got a Wheel of Fortune yet? Now might be the time to build one; the Nevada Gaming Commission is offering a $500 bonus if you can get twenty gamblers to hit the Wheel within the next twenty-four hours.
ID_SCENARIO_CS_BUSINESSFOLK_DESC:
It's the Annual General Conference of Cairn-Muntings Associates Inc, which means that a large number of managers from CMA's regional divisions have turned up in Vegas, looking to spend about 12% of their time thinking 'outside the box' vis-a-vis business matters, then spending the rest of their time getting 'out of their box' at the local nightclubs and gin joints. To win this objective, you'll need to have made 300 'businessperson' sales from Clubs, Nightclubs, Exclusive Nightclubs and Cocktail bars by the end of Day Eight.

You'll need to beat this objective if you want to complete the scenario. Good luck!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_COUNTRYFANS_DESC:
Dust off your Stetsons and give your spurs a buff; it's the annual Vegas Country Music meet! Two hundred Country Music fans have come a-rollin' into town! Anyone from the following people types qualify as Country Music fans:

  Hardcore Gamblers
  Male Parents
  Female Parents
  'Slots' Ladies
  Wedding Party Males
  Wedding Party Females
  Retired Men
  Retired Women
  Sad Drunks

They're looking to spend a little cash, so why not go find out what they're after?
ID_SCENARIO_CS_CRAPSEXPOSE_DESC: Get twenty gamblers to hit any of your craps tables (if you've got any that is...) in the next eight hours, and you'll make $2,500 from the Nevada Gaming Commission!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_DRAKE_DESC: Star of hit Sci-Fi show 'Eye of Uranus' Hamilton Drake has arrived in town. He's very rich, with very expensive tastes. He'll be in town for the next two days; give him what he wants in that time and he'll pay top dollar for your services!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_DRAKE_NAME: Hamilton Drake is in Las Vegas!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_DRAKELOSE_DESC: Mr. Drake is leaving your lot. He was somewhat disappointed by the lack of quality facilities that he found there.
ID_SCENARIO_CS_DRAKELOSE_NAME: Hamilton Drake is leaving your Lot.
ID_SCENARIO_CS_DRAKEWIN_DESC: You've done well, Mr. Drake has had a great time!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_DRAKEWIN_NAME: Hamilton Drake is leaving your Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_GASLEAK_DESC: Problems, problems! There's been a gas leak on your property, and all of your buildings are so badly damaged they've needed to be shut down. Your repair-men need to get to work so you can start making money again!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_LEGENDCOMING_DESC:
Country legend Mason Jeffries (singer of such well-loved tunes as 'Come Take my Hand, but don't Touch my Whisky' and 'The Deep, Dark Night') is coming to Vegas to perform a gig! While he's in town, he'll be looking for country music, booze and poker (Texas Hold 'Em's his game of choice). He's also quite partial to junk food, has a thing for showgirls, and of course he'll need somewhere 'earthy' to stay.

He'll be here in four hours time, and if you make him happy, he'll tip you $3,000! Excellent!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_LEGENDHERE_DESC: The world's best loved Country Music star is here in Las Vegas. Are you ready for him?
ID_SCENARIO_CS_LORDCOMING_DESC:
Lord Alistair Fforking-Smythe is coming to Las Vegas in very shortly to see what all the fuss is about! Quite apart from being a Lord, he is also an immensely successful businessman, and is here to deliver a lecture on a system he calls 'The Fforking Way', a particularly aggressive form of employee motivation which involves shouting, the occasional birching, summary executions and the like. While he's here, he'll probably be on the lookout for gambling (Caribbean Stud Poker's his game), fine art, fancy clothing, classical music and somewhere quiet where he can contemplate history.

Make him happy, and he'll tip you $6,000. Wow, what a guy.
ID_SCENARIO_CS_LORDHERE_DESC: The erstwhile Lord Fforking-Smythe has come to the Strip! Has your complex got what it takes to give him a massive coronary? I mean, make him happy?
ID_SCENARIO_CS_MASON_DESC:
Country legend Mason Jeffries (singer of such well-loved tunes as 'Come Take my Hand, but don't Touch my Whisky' and 'The Deep, Dark Night') is coming to Vegas to perform a gig! While he's in town, he'll be looking for country music, booze and poker (Texas Hold 'Em's his game of choice). He's also quite partial to junk food, has a thing for showgirls, and of course he'll need somewhere 'earthy' to stay.

He'll be here in four hours time, and if you make him happy, he'll tip you $3,000! Excellent!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_MASONLOSE_DESC: He didn't really enjoy himself. He was looking for something a little wilder! Afraid to say that he's going to hold on to that $3,000 for the time being; unlucky!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_MASONWIN_DESC: He had a terrific time! He had so much fun, in fact, that he's decided to chuck $3,000 your way. Pretty sweet!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_MASONWIN_NAME: Mason Jeffries is leaving your lot!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_MORECOUNTRYFANS_DESC: Head 'em up, move 'em on! More Country fans have come rollin', rollin' rollin' onto the Strip!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_BUSINESS_DESC:
It's the Annual General Conference of Cairn-Muntings Associates Inc, which means that a large number of managers from CMA's regional divisions have turned up in Vegas, looking to spend about 12% of their time thinking 'outside the box' vis-a-vis business matters, then spending the rest of their time getting 'out of their box' at the local nightclubs and gin joints. To win this objective, you'll need to have made 300 'businessperson' sales from the following businesses by the end of Day Eight:

  Clubs
  Nightclubs
  Exclusive Nightclubs
  Cocktail Bars

You'll need to beat this objective if you want to complete the scenario. Good luck!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_BUSINESS_LOSENOSALES_: You didn't make enough businessperson sales by the deadline, and have therefore failed both this objective and the scenario overall. Shame! But hey, why not try again?
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_BUSINESSWIN_DESC: By making 300 businessperson sales by the end of Day Eight, you've successfully beaten this objective. Great job!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_COUNTRY_DESC:
Make 150 ticket sales from a Country Music event on your Lot by the end of Day Four.  The following people types qualify as fans:

  Hardcore Gamblers
  Male Parents
  Female Parents
  'Slots' Ladies
  Wedding Party Males
  Wedding Party Females
  Retired Men
  Retired Women
  Sad Drunks

To get these people onto your Lot, you'll need to build a Live Music Venue with the Country upgrade, as well as all of the other shops and services that a C & W fan might want. Good luck!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_COUNTRY_LOSENOLMV_DES: Because you failed to build a Live Music Venue, you've not been able to make any Country Music sales by the deadline. That means you've failed this objective and the scenario overall. Unlucky! But hey, why not have another try?
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_COUNTRY_LOSENOSALES_D: Bad luck, chum! You didn't get enough visitors to your Country Music Event by the deadline. That means you've lost this objective and the scenario overall.
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_COUNTRY_LOSENOUPGRADE: You built the Live Music Venue, but neglected to fit it out with the Country Music upgrade. That means you weren't able to make any Country Music sales, and have therefore failed this objective and the scenario overall. But hey, why not have another try?
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_COUNTRYWIN_DESC:
You've succeeded in getting 150 visitors to your Country Music Event before the deadline. Good work; you're one step closer to completing the scenario! Not only that, but CAWAGA (the Country And Western Appreciation Group of America) have sent you a gift worth $6,000 as a token of their appreciation. Excellent!

But you're not in the clear yet, as there's another objective right around the corner...
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_CRAPS2_DESC: Get twenty gamblers to hit any of your craps tables (if you've got any that is...) in the next eight hours, and you'll make $2,500 from the Nevada Gaming Commission!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_CRAPSFAIL_DESC: You failed to get twenty gamblers to any of your craps tables before the deadline. No NGC bonus for you!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_CRAPSWIN_DESC: You made twenty craps sales by the deadline! Here: have $2,500! Mmm, money good...
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_LEGEND_DESC:
Country legend Mason Jeffries is coming to Vegas to perform a gig! While he's in town, he'll be looking for the following:

  Country Music
  Bar
  Texas Hold 'Em
  Small Hotel
  Fast Food

He'll be in town for a few days and if he stays on your property he'll draw country music fans to the Lot in droves. If you make him happy, he'll tip you $3,000!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_LEGENDLOSE_DESC: ...looking a little tired and irritated. It doesn't seem like he had a great time on your Lot. He probably won't be giving you that $3,000 now. Shame.
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_LEGENDLOSE_NAME: Mason Jeffries is leaving Las Vegas...
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_LEGENDWIN_DESC: ...with a big smile on his face. He had an awesome time on your Lot, so here's $3,000 to show how happy he is! Well alright!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_LORD_DESC:
Lord Alistair Fforking-Smythe is coming to Las Vegas to see what all the fuss is about! Quite apart from being a Lord, he is also an immensely successful businessman, and is here to deliver a lecture to the CMA Conference on a system he calls 'The Fforking Way', a particularly aggressive form of employee motivation which involves shouting, the occasional birching, summary executions and the like. His tastes are as follows:

  Caribbean Stud Poker
  Art Galleries
  Men's Clothing Stores
  Live Music (String Quartets)
  Museums
  Cocktail Bars
  A la Carte Restaurants
  High Roller Suites

Make him happy, and he'll tip you $6,000!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_LORDLOSE_DESC: Lord Fforking-Smythe is leaving Las Vegas. Your entertainment complex offered scant diversion for a man of such exquisite tastes. No large pay-off for you. Bah!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_LORDWIN_DESC: Lord Fforking-Smythe has had the time of his life at your shops, services and attractions, and is leaving a happy man. Here's $6,000 of his 'hard earned' dollars as a token of his esteem! Good show, old bean!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_MOSTFANS_DESC: Get the most fans onto your property by the end of convention season: day eight!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_MOSTFANS_NAME: GET THE MOST FANS ON YOUR LOT BY END OF DAY SEVEN
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_RESTAURANT_DESC: Make 70 restaurant sales in the next twenty-four hours (from either your standard Restaurant or the A la Carte version) and receive a commendation from Good Eatin' Magazine! This will improve the reputation of that Lot by 20 points!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_RESTAURANTFAIL_DESC: Well, you failed to make 70 restaurant sales in the time allowed, so Good Eatin' Magazine won't be recommending your services to their readers. It's a shame!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_RESTAURANTWIN_DESC: You've made 70 restaurant sales in one day. Good Eatin' magazine have awarded your Restaurants three forks out of four; pretty strong recommendation there. Your Lot's reputation has leapt by 20 points!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_VISITORSRACE_DESC: There are a few objectives you'll need to complete this scenario. Here's the biggest: be the first Vegas tycoon to get make 5,000 total sales from your Lots' businesses. You're up against the slow but meticulous Derren Languid, the bullish but determined Hal Harding and the briskly efficient Chase Lanyon, so best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_VISITORSRACE_P1WIN_DE: Excellent work: you were the first make 5,000 sales! Your competitors - especially infamously sore loser Hal Harding - are fuming!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_VISITORSRACE_P2WIN_DE: Dang! Celebrity photographer Derren Languid was the first entrepreneur to make 5,000 Lot sales. He couldn't be happier! Unfortunately, that means you've lost this objective and the scenario over all. Why not have another try?
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_VISITORSRACE_P3WIN_DE: Steel Magnate Hal Harding was the first to make 5,000 sales. He sure is pleased with himself. Unfortunately for you, this means that you've lost the objective and the scenario over all.
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_VISITORSRACE_P4WIN_DE: Zoom! Miss Chase Lanyon was the first across the finish line, easily making the 5,000 sales necessary to beat the scenario. Bad luck, though: you've lost the objective and the scenario over all! Why not have another try?
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_VISITORSRACEP2WARNING: Derren Languid is this close to making 5,000 Lot sales! He's at 4950 at the moment: time to get moving!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_VISITORSRACEP3WARNING: Hal Harding has managed to make 4950 sales already; 50 more like that and he'll have won! Make sure you beat him to the prize!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_OBJ_VISITORSRACEP4WARNING: Chase Lanyon is zooming ahead: she's made 4950 total sales from her Lot already! Make sure you beat her across the finish line!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_P2CASINO_DESC: Derren Languid has built himself a Medium Casino! It's full of groovy things to keep visitors happy, so watch out!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_P2CONV_DESC: Derren Languid has noticed that you've built yourself a Live Music Venue, so he's decided to build himself something pretty mighty himself: a Business Center! This is a great way to bring business people onto your Lot, which is something you may want to bear in mind...
ID_SCENARIO_CS_P3CASINO_DESC: Hal Harding has built himself a Large Casino! You remember how powerful his last one was, right? Well, this one's just as awesome! Keep your eye on it!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_P3HOTEL_DESC: Hal Harding has done built himself a Large Hotel! He's right proud of it, too!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_P3NIGHTCLUB_DESC: Hal Harding couldn't help but notice that you've built yourself a Nightclub. He quite liked the look of it, so he's built one for himself!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_P4CARPARK_DESC: Chase Lanyon has built herself a Car Park! These are a) a good place for her to park her fleet of racing cars and b) a great way of bringing lots of people directly onto your Lot. Pretty useful, all in all! You might want to bear that in mind for future reference.
ID_SCENARIO_CS_P4CASINO_DESC: Chase Lanyon has just decided to build herself a Large Casino. Take a look at it by clicking on the link below!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_PLAYER1WON_DESC: You've succeeded in building up the most appealing convention complex! That's this scenario completed!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_PLAYER2WON_DESC: Holy cow! He's astonished that he's succeeded in building up the most appealing convention complex! Why not have another go, and see if you can beat him this time?
ID_SCENARIO_CS_PLAYER3WON_DESC: The tough-as-nails steel magnate has trounced all opposition and built the most appealing convention complex. Perhaps you need to be more ruthless in future?
ID_SCENARIO_CS_PLAYER4WON_DESC: She's romped over the finish line with the most successful convention complex on the Strip. Why not have another go, and see if you can beat her to the prize?
ID_SCENARIO_CS_RESTAURANTEXPOSE_DESC: Make 70 restaurant sales in the next twenty-four hours (from either your standard Restaurant or the A la Carte version) and receive a commendation from Good Eatin' Magazine! This will improve the reputation of the Lot on which the Restaurant stands by 20 points!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_SCIFIFANS_DESC: A gaggle of Science Fiction fans have arrived in Las Vegas. They have unusual tastes, but plenty of disposable income!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_STARTUPMESSAGE_DESC:
It's convention season, baby! This year there are a couple of major conventions that are due to hit the Strip: one, a Country & Western fan event and the other an as-yet unknown event. To complete this scenario, you'll have a couple of objectives to beat right from the outset, namely:

Be the first Vegas entrepreneur to make 5,000 sales (of any kind) from their Lot.

Make 150 Country Music sales by the end of Day Four.

But that's just for starters: when the second convention hits town, you'll have to be ready for that too!

This time, you'll be up against rival entrepreneurs Derren Languid, Hal Harding and Chase Lanyon. Keep your eyes on the prize, kiddo!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_STORM_DESC: It's raining rain, hallelujah! This doesn't happen that often out here in the desert, but when it does it REALLY goes for it!
ID_SCENARIO_CS_STRIKE_DESC: Lightning strikes! One of the buildings on the Strip has been blasted by a bolt from the blue; click the link below to see if it's one of yours!
ID_SCENARIO_GENERAL_DONE: This scenario is now finished. Would you like to continue playing?
ID_SCENARIO_GENERAL_LOST: Bad luck, you have failed to complete the scenario. Would you like to continue playing?
ID_SCENARIO_GENERAL_WON: Well done, you have beaten this scenario! Would you like to continue playing?
ID_SCENARIO_HH_ADAMHAPPY: Adam Crosby is now leaving the City. He's had a great time at your entertainment complex!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_ADAMSAD: Adam Crosby is now leaving the City. He hasn't found much on your lot to keep him interested...
ID_SCENARIO_HH_BUSINESSMANCOMING_DESC:
Heads up! In eleven hours time, insanely wealthy Italian 'businessman' Armand D'Angelo is coming to see how his Las Vegas 'interests' are doing, and to enjoy the local entertainment while he's here! He'll be after a little poker, a lot of cocktails and something that'll make him laugh. He also has a taste for jazz music, expensive rings and cufflinks and, of course, he'll need somewhere to stay.

Satisfy his needs, and he'll tip you $10,000! Make him unhappy and, well... he may have to send 'the boys' round. You've been warned!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_BUSINESSMANHERE_DESC: Mr D'Angelo has arrived in town. Are you ready for him? Click the link below to find out where he is and what he's up to!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_CELEBCOMING_DESC:
Feuding Hollywood couple Joyce Crosby (world-famous actress) and Adam Crosby (notoriously hot-tempered director) are coming to town in ten hours time! Both are very rich but detest each other, so expect smashed hotel rooms, and fights in restaurants and bars. It's gonna be a mess, no doubt about it. Joyce has a thing for rock bands, movies, a little light gambling and dancing. Adam will no doubt be looking for sexy ladies, booze, fast food and video games. Both of them will also need somewhere to stay, of course.

Make one of them happy and you'll receive $6,000. Make both of them happy and you'll make twice that! Go get 'em, tiger!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_CELEBENTRY: Feuding celebrity couple Joyce and Adam Crosby have arrived in town! Both are stinking rich but hate each other with a passion, so expect trouble! Keep an eye out for smashed-up hotel rooms, fights in restaurants and the like.
ID_SCENARIO_HH_CELEBHERE_DESC: Joyce and Adam Crosby are now both in town, and all heck is about to break loose! Click the link below to find where Joyce is in the world and what she's up to!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_CELEBWHALEHERE_DESC: Adam Crosby has come to the Strip, looking for a little action. Click the link below to find out where he is and what he's doing!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_DUPONT: Wealthy widow Grace Morley-Jones has just purchased a Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_DUST_DESC: As you can see, a sand storm has struck the Strip! Half of the Vegas visitors have decided they've had enough of the appalling weather and have decided to get out while the going is good. This could complicate things!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_EARTHTREMOR: An earth tremor has struck the Nevada desert! All buildings have been severely damaged! Get to work, before your customers start leaving in droves!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_FEMALECELEBCOMING_DESC:
Miss Tia Jackson is on her way! She's the toast of Hollywood, star of such blockbusters as 'The Fire Within', 'New York Nights' and 'The Shadow King', and she's coming to Las Vegas in six hours with plenty of time to kill and a lot of money to spend! She'll be in the mood for a little pampering, expensive clothing, and lots of shiny trinkets. She also LOVES to dance, occasionally likes to gamble, and will need someone to help her stay trim and beautiful.

Make her happy, and she'll tip you $5,000!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_FEMALECELEBHERE_DESC: Hollywood starlet Tia Jackson has dropped into Las Vegas! Are you ready for her?
ID_SCENARIO_HH_HALHARDING: Derren Languid has just purchased a Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_HELLS_DESC: A few chapters of the Hell's Angels have rolled into town for a meet! Expect an abundance of trashy-hopeful types to hit the Strip. These guys like their entertainment fast, dirty and cheap!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_JOYCEHAPPY: Joyce Crosby is leaving the City. She's had a whale of a time on your Lot, and may well be back for more! In the meantime, here's $6,000 of her cash!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_JOYCESAD: Joyce Crosby is now leaving the city. She's a little ticked off with the service she's found on your Lot... No $6,000 payout, man!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_BUSINESSMAN_DESC:
Heads up! Insanely wealthy Italian 'businessman' Armand D'Angelo is coming to see how his Las Vegas 'interests' are doing, and to enjoy a little entertainment while he's here! He'll be after Poker, A la Carte Restaurants, Jazz, Cocktails, Stand-Up Comedy, Jewelry and a High Roller Suite to stay in.

Satisfy his needs, and he'll tip you $10,000! Make him unhappy and, well... he may have to send 'the boys' round. You've been warned, man!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_BUSINESSMANLOSE_DESC: Mr D'Angelo would like it to be known that he found your casino complex to be below par. He has decided to take this as a personal insult, and may send some heavies round to your house for a quiet little chat... Also, no $10,000 bonus for you! Shame, that might have covered your hospital bills.
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_BUSINESSMANWIN_DESC: Mr D'Angelo is very pleased: you showed him and his friends great courtesy. Good service, plenty to keep him busy. Good work, all in all, so here's a $10,000 tip. Don't spend it all at once, bucko!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_CELEB_DESC:
Feuding Hollywood couple Joyce and Adam Crosby are coming to Las Vegas in ten hours time! Both are very rich but detest each other, so expect smashed hotel rooms, and fights in restaurants and bars. It's gonna be a mess, no doubt about it. Joyce is coming into town first, and she has a taste for:

  Rock Bands
  Cocktails
  Craps
  Cinemas
  Clubbing
  Nice Hotels

Adam will be along a little while afterwards, and you'll find he'll be looking for:

  Lap Dancers
  Bars
  Pole Dancers
  Arcades
  Nice Hotel

Make one of them happy and you'll receive $6,000. Make both of them happy and you'll get twice that!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_CELEB2_DESC:
Joyce's errant partner is coming to Las Vegas! Remember, while he's here he's going to be looking for:

  Lap Dancers
  Bars
  Pole Dancers
  Arcades
  Medium Hotels

And if you make him happy, he'll give you a gift $6,000. Alright!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_CELEBFEMALELOSE_DESC: Ms. Crosby's had a rubbish time! She's not giving you any of her money! At all!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_CELEBFEMALELOSE_NAME: Joyce Crosby is getting out of town
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_CELEBFEMALEWIN_DESC: Ms. Crosby had the time of her life, all the better for not having that odious cretin hanging off her arm! She's so happy, she's decided to give you $6,000! Well done!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_CELEBFEMALEWIN_NAME: Joyce Crosby is leaving the Strip!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_CELEBMALELOSE_DESC: Yeah, Mr Crosby is out of here. He had a pretty miserable time, all in all. This means no $6,000 bonus for you, sad to say!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_CELEBMALELOSE_NAME: Adam Crosby is getting out of town
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_CELEBMALEWIN_DESC: Adam Crosby had a terrific time, all the better for not being with that 'witless harpy'! He's so delighted with his new freedom, he's giving you $6,000! Good work!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_CELEBMALEWIN_NAME: Adam Crosby is leaving Las Vegas!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_FEMALECELEB_DESC:
Miss Tia Jackson is on her way! She's the toast of Hollywood, star of such blockbusters as 'The Fire Within', 'New York Nights' and 'The Shadow King', and she's coming to Las Vegas with plenty of time to kill and a lot of money to spend! She's looking for the following:

  Beauty Parlours
  Women's Clothing Stores
  Jewelry Stores
  Exclusive Nightclubs
  Personal Trainers
  Gambling
  Large Hotels

Make her happy, and she'll tip you $5,000!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_FEMALECELEBLOSE_DESC: She didn't really enjoy herself at all on your Lot, and won't be giving you that $5,000 now. Shame!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_FEMALECELEBLOSE_NAME: Tia Jackson is out of here!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_FEMALECELEBWIN_DESC: Miss Jackson had a sweet time, and she's going to tell her friends back in LA all about your fantastic leisure complex! Also, here's that $5,000! Good job!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_FEMALECELEBWIN_NAME: Tia Jackson is leaving the Strip!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_GUESTS_DESC:
Be the first player to attract a total of 1,000 prestigious guests to your hotel complex! Prestigious guests are any of the following people types:

  Male High Rollers
  Female High Rollers
  Celebrities
  'Whales'
  Businessmen
  Businesswomen

You'll need to make your hotel complex the best in town, with health spas, swimming pools, restaurants, cocktail bars, nightclubs, theaters, etc.
 Get to work!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_GUESTS_P2WON_DESC: Bad luck, Grace Morley-Jones was the first to get 1,000 guests at her hotel complex; she's laughing cruelly even as we speak. Bad news for you though; this means you've failed this objective and the scenario over all.
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_GUESTS_P3WON_DESC: Unlucky! Hal Harding was the first entrepreneur to get 1,000 prestigious guests into his hotel complex. He can scarcely contain his mirth! Unfortunately for you, however, this means that you've failed this objective and the scenario itself is forfeit. But hey, why not give it another try?
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_GUESTS_P4WON_DESC: Tough luck, kid! Fashionista Michel Dupont has taken the prize for getting 1,000 prestigious guests to his hotel complex before any of his rivals. That, sadly, means, you've failed this objective and the scenario over all. But hey, why not give it another go? It's bound to go better for you next time 'round!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_GUESTSDONE_DESC: Good work, you were the first Vegas entrepreneur to get 1,000 prestigious guests to visit your hotel complex! But there's still one objective to go before you can complete this scenario!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_GUESTSDONEWIN_DESC: Congratulations, you were the first to get 1,000 prestigious guests to your hotel complex AND you managed to get 200 High Rollers into your casinos within one day. Great job!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_GUESTSP2WARNING_DESC: Grace Morley-Jones is only 50 guests away from beating you to the prize. Move faster!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_GUESTSP3WARNING_DESC: Michel Dupont needs only 50 more guests in order to win the scenario! Don't let him get away with it!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_GUESTSP4WARNING_DESC: Yee-haw! Hal Harding is only 50 guests away from beating you to the goal! Get goin'!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_HOTELGUESTS_COMPLETE: Congratulations, you've built up the most exciting, attractive lot, and succeeded in drawing sixty prestigious guests to it!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_HOTELGUESTS_DESC: Attract 1,000 prestigious guests to your hotels. You'll need to make your hotel complex the best in town, with health spas, swimming pools, restaurants, cocktail bars, nightclubs, theaters, etc.
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_ROLLERS_DESC: This is another objective you'll need to beat if you want to complete this scenario; get 200 High Rollers into your casinos in any one day. Remember, high rollers want to see the best that Vegas has to offer, so treat 'em right if you want them to come visit your Lot. Good luck!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_ROLLERSDONE_DESC: Well, alright! You managed to get 200 High Rollers into your casino complex in one day. Good work! But remember, there's still one other objective to beat before the scenario is fully complete!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_ROLLERSDONEWIN_DESC:
Good work; you managed to get 200 High Rollers into your casino complex in one day. You've also managed to get 1,000 prestigious guests onto your property before any of your rivals, so that means this scenario has been completed!

Excellent work!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_SCIFI_DESC:
Star of Sci-Fi hit 'Eye of Uranus' Hamilton Drake is coming to Las Vegas! He's a pretty rich guy, and he fondly imagines himself to be a man of both wealth and taste. While he's here, he's going to be on the lookout for Theaters, Men's Clothing stores, Gymnasiums, Health Spas and any kind of gambling. He'll also be needing a decent quality Hotel to stay in. 

Make him happy during his time here and he'll tip you $2,500!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_SCIFILOSE_DESC: Hamilton Drake is out of here, having had a miserable time. He's going to head back to Hollywood, where they REALLY know how to treat their stars! Bad luck!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_SCIFILOSE_NAME: Mr. Drake is getting out of town
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_SCIFIWIN_DESC: He described his experience as 'out of this world'! What a chump. Still, here's $2,500 of his cash - spend it wisely!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_SCIFIWIN_NAME: Mr. Drake is leaving Las Vegas!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_SHEIK_DESC:
Wealthy Arab businessman Ibrahim Khan is coming to Las Vegas with an extraordinary amount of cash to spend. His tastes run towards the following:

  A la Carte Restaurants
  Masseuses
  Exclusive Nightclubs
  Art Galleries
  Baccarat Tables
  High Roller Suites

Satisfy his needs and he will reimburse you to the tune of $9,000!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_SHEIKLOSE_DESC: Ibrahim Khan is getting out of Las Vegas. He did not enjoy himself a great deal, and will not be giving you any money. Bad luck!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_OBJ_SHEIKWIN_DESC: Ibrahim Khan is heading out of town. He has had a wonderful time, and is giving you $9,000 to show his gratitude!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_P2CARPARK_DESC: Grace Morley-Jones has spotted that you've built your own Car Park. She's thinking these might prove quite useful, and has built one of her own!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_P2LARGECASINO_DESC: Grace Morley-Jones has built a Large Casino. It's jam-packed with games and features, and could prove a real threat!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_P2LARGEHOTEL_DESC: Grace Morley-Jones has built herself a Large Hotel! Keep an eye on her...
ID_SCENARIO_HH_P3NEWLOT_DESC: Michel Dupont has decided to branch out, and has bought himself a new Lot on which to build!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_P4LARGECASINO_DESC: Hal Harding has built himself a Large Casino! He's proved mighty fond of these, hasn't he? Watch out though, this one's just as powerful as his last two!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_POWERRISE: Due to the earlier seismic disturbance, local water treatment plants and power stations have greatly increased the price of their service. Save yourself some money by building your own water treatment stations and power generators!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_ROLLERS1_DESC: There's a party going on right here... It's the social event of the month, the birthday of high society gal Lorena Raymond. Expect a flood of High Rollers to come into town to show their face at this big bash, and to no doubt spend a little money at the local casinos and attractions!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_ROLLERS2_DESC: Daniel Raymond, Lorena's older brother, has decided to hold a birthday bash of his own. More High Rollers will be hitting the Strip pretty soon!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_SCIFICOMING_DESC:
Star of Sci-Fi hit 'Eye of Uranus' Hamilton Drake is coming to Las Vegas! He's a pretty rich guy, and he fondly imagines himself to be a man of both wealth and taste. While he's here, he's going to be on the lookout for expensive clothing, somewhere to work out and somewhere to relax. He also has a bit of a gambling habit, and a real love of the theater. Of course, he'll also need somewhere to stay, and only the very best will do.

Make him happy during his time here and he'll tip you $2,500!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_SCIFIHERE_DESC: Hamilton Drake is in town, with a load of money burning a hole in his wallet. Do what you can to relieve him of his cash!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_SHEIKCOMING_DESC:
Wealthy Arab businessman Ibrahim Khan will be coming to Las Vegas in six hours time with an extraordinary amount of cash to spend. While he's on the Strip, he'll almost certainly be looking for somewhere to get a luxurious back rub, some top quality food, the finest artworks and some high-stakes, high class gambling. He's also been known to enjoy a bit of a boogie from time to time...

Satisfy his needs and he will reimburse you to the tune of $9,000!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_SHEIKHERE_DESC: Ibrahim Khan has arrived on the Strip! If you want his money, make sure your Lot is ready for him!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_STARTUPMESSAGE:
With this scenario, you're going to need to appeal to the higher end of the Vegas market, the 'Prestigious guests'. These are pretty tricky customers, as you're about to find out!

'Prestigious guests' include High Rollers, Celebrities, 'Whales' and Business people.

You'll need to be the first Vegas entrepreneur to make 1,000 'prestigious' sales from your hotels!

To fully complete the scenario, you'll also need to get 200 High Rollers to visit your casino complex in any one day.

But watch out, because you're up against Michel Dupont, as well as two of the toughest entrepreneurs on the Strip: wealthy widow Grace Morley-Jones and steel magnate Hal Harding!

Stay sharp!
ID_SCENARIO_HH_WATERINCREASE_DESC: Water shortage! The local water treatment plant and power station have upped the price of their services to compensate for a water shortage. Build your own water treatment and power generation facilities to deal with this problem!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_BIDDIES_DESC: Coach loads of retired citizens have arrived in Las Vegas! Each has a lifetime's worth of savings to fritter away, and no time to lose!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_BIDDIES_NAME: Many old folk hit the Strip!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_BIDDIES1_DESC: It's Ruth McConnell's 80th Birthday, and as a treat her friends from the Senior Citizens Association of Residential Florida have decided to go on a long break in Las Vegas. Expect at least a hundred old folk swarming around the City for a while; they've got a lifetime of savings to spend, and no time to lose!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_BIDDIES2_DESC: Mrs. McConnell couldn't stay away, so she's brought her silver-haired posse back to take Vegas by storm! Zimmer alert!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_BIGFIGHTLOST_DESC: Bad luck; you've missed the chance to host the Big Fight on your lot. But there'll be other big events, so keep an eye out for them!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_BIGFIGHTLOST_NAME: Fight Night has passed you by!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_BIGFIGHTWARNING_DESC:
The Big Fight - a heavyweight bout between reigning champion 'The Mighty' Samson Stone and young hopeful Johnny Cage - is coming to Vegas! Make sure you offer the best facilities for the boxing match of the year: a hotel for the boxers to stay in, and an arena in which the bout can be staged. 

This is going to be a little tough, but why not give it go? The big event happens in 3 days time.
ID_SCENARIO_KH_BIGFIGHTWIN_DESC: Well done, you've successfully brought the boxing match of the year to your lot!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_BIGFIGHTWIN_NAME: Fight Night, on your lot tonight!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_BUILDSLOT_DESC: Starting from now, if you place 12 slot machines in any of your casinos you'll receive a $3,000 prize from the Nevada Gaming Commission for offering outstanding service!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_DUSTSTORM_DESC: This happens out here in the desert from time to time; a huge sandstorm has swept in from the plains and engulfed the Strip. The terrified visitors are leaving the Strip in droves!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_EDGECHANGELOW_DESC: In response to you building your second casino, Michel Dupont has decided to raise the house edge on all of the tables in his casino to the 'High' setting. This means the prospective gambler is a little more likely to lose at this kind of table, and slightly increases Michel Dupont's chances of making money from the punters. Not a bad strategy in some respects, but what Dupont gains in wealth he may lose in reputation; people don't like to be ripped off...
ID_SCENARIO_KH_EDGECHANGEMEDIUM_DESC: In response to you building your second casino, Michel Dupont has decided to raise the house edge on all of the tables in his casino to the 'Criminal' setting. This means the prospective gambler is more likely to lose at this kind of table, and increases Michel Dupont's chances of making money from the punters. Not a bad strategy in some respects, but what Dupont gains in wealth he may lose in reputation; people don't like to be ripped off...
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_ADVERTISING_DESC:
By the end of Day Four, spend $3,000 on promoting your Lot. The best way to promote your Lot is to build some of the following buildings:

  Any kind of Statue
  Any kind of Sign
  A Display Stage

This'll really help your Lot to sell itself to the punters!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_ADVERTISING_DONE_DESC: Good work; you managed to spend $3,000 on promoting your Lot before the deadline! But there's still work to be done if you want to complete the Scenario; go for it, kid!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_ADVERTISING_LOSE_DESC: Bad luck; you've failed to spend $3,000 on promoting your Lot by the deadline. You'll never make it big in Vegas if you don't promote what you've got! Never mind, you can always give it another try.
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_ADVERTISING_WON_DESC: Excellent job: you've spent $3,000 on Lot promotion by the deadline. As you've also successfully beaten all other objectives, that means this scenario is now complete! You're top dog; good work!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_BUILDSLOT_DESC: Starting from now, if you place 12 slot machines in any of your casinos you'll receive a $3,000 prize from the Nevada Gaming Commission for offering outstanding service!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_BUILDSLOT_WON_DESC: Well done, you've built twelve slot machines! Here's $3,000 from the Nevada Gaming Commission; don't spend it all at once!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_GAMBLERS_DESC: Tempt a further 1,500 visitors into your casinos by the end of Day Eight! You'll stand a better chance of doing this if you fill your casino floor with as many games and fun features as you can. But remember, you'll also need to equip your casino with all the necessary infrastructure to ensure that it keeps running smoothly. Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_GAMBLERS_LOSE_DESC: Bad luck, pal; you failed to get 1,500 more visitors to your casinos by the deadline. This means the scenario is lost. But hey, you can always have another go!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_GAMBLERS_NAME: Get 1,500 further visits to your casinos!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_GAMBLERS_WON_DESC: Congratulations, you successfully got 1,500 more visitors to come to your casino complex! You've made (at least) that number of people either very broke or very happy; either way, it's a good few days' work! Excellent!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_GAMBLERS_WON_END_DESC: You've succeeded in getting 1,500 further gamblers to come and spend their money at your casinos! That's all three objectives for this scenario beaten; Good work!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_MEDIUM_DESC: By the end of Day Three, build a Small Hotel and a Small Casino in order to satisfy customer demand. Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_MEDIUM_LOSE_DESC: Because you didn't build a Small Casino and a Small Hotel before the deadline, you've failed to complete this scenario. Bad luck, man!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_MEDIUM_NAME: Build a Casino and a Hotel
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_MEDIUM_WON_DESC:
Well done, you built a Small Hotel and a Small Casino before the deadline! This has earned you a big 'thumbs up' from the people on the Strip! But you can't rest up just yet, as a new objective has been unlocked!

By the end of Day Eight, get a further 1,500 visitors into your casinos!

Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_MEDIUM_WON_END_DESC: You've successfully constructed a Small Hotel and a Small Casino before the deadline. That's all three objectives for this scenario beaten; Congratulations!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_OBJ_SIGNS_WON_END_DESC: Well done, you've erected two Medium Signs. That's all three objectives completed, and this scenario well and truly beaten! Great job!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_P2CASINO_DESC: Michel Dupont has built his own Casino! It's only a small one, but there's still plenty of room inside for games and features. Watch out!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_P2MEDIUMSIGN_DESC: Your rival has built a Medium Sign. Remember, these are a great way of getting people to come visit your Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_P2NIGHTCLUB_DESC: Just for your information - Michel Dupont has built a Nightclub. These can be pretty powerful attractors to the people on the Strip, so keep an eye on it...
ID_SCENARIO_KH_PRICEDROP_DESC: Michel Dupont has noticed that you've built yourself a Jewelry Store. He doesn't like where this is going (Jewelry Store's are very high profit businesses), and so has decided to drop the prices in all of his retail outlets to tempt your customers away. Pretty sneaky!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_ROLLER_DESC: A large number of wealthy High Rollers have swung into town. There are about forty of them in all: very wealthy individuals who are quite difficult to please. Bring them to your casino complex and you can charge them top dollar for your games and services! Use the View Filters to find out where the High Rollers are and what they're doing!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_STARTUPMESSAGE_DESC:
Alright, now we're down to the nitty-gritty. This time round, you're going to have your casino-building skills tested; over the course of the scenario, you'll need to build up a casino complex that'll really draw in the punters. To that end, you need to complete the following two objectives:

Build a Small Hotel and Small Casino by the end of Day Three.

Spend $3,000 on promoting your Lot (by building Statues, Signs or Display Stages) by the end of Day Four. This'll really help your entertainment complex to sell itself!

But that's not at all: be ready for another, hidden objective that'll crop up as you play through the scenario. Your opponent this time is fastidious fashion guru Michel Dupont. Good luck: we're rooting for ya!
ID_SCENARIO_KH_STARTUPMESSAGE_NAME: Scenario Two - King of the Hill
ID_SCENARIO_KH_STRIKE_DESC: One of your buildings has been struck by a bolt from the blue! Its health has been reduced to zero, and it needs immediate repair! Hit the link below to find out which one's been damaged!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB1_DESC: Magnus Carter has hit the Strip! Click the button below to find out where he is and what he's doing!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB1COMING_DESC: Grr! 'Mangled Heart' front man and God of Goth Rock Magnus Carter is coming back to town in seven hours to perform at the Montys! Beforehand of course, he's going to kick back with about a thousand cold brews and plenty of groupies. While he's here he's going to be looking for booze, some particularly exciting activity, video games, somewhere to have a dance, and somewhere to stay. He also loves sharks, remember!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB2_DESC: Joel Devlin has arrived! Click on the link below to find out where he is and what he's doing!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB2COMING_DESC:
He's bad! King of Eighties beat Joel Devlin is coming back to town in four hours time for the big event: the Montys! He's probably the world's most famous man, so he's got a ton of money to spend and plenty of time on his hands. He's after a bit of this, right: soft drinks, some kind of thrill-ride, video games, fast food... oh, and he also LOVES magic. You'll also need to build him somewhere to stay.

Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB3_DESC: He's here; Danny Jackson is back on the Strip, looking for action! Click the button below to find out where he is and what he's doing!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB3COMING_DESC:
Professional golfer Danny 'Swingmaster General' Jackson is coming to town in six hours, in order to get a good seat at the Montys awards ceremony! He's got a little time to kill before the ceremony and is STILL absolutely loaded. While he's on the Strip, he'll be looking for a little sports book betting, soft drinks, a little exercise (with a personal touch, for preference) and somewhere to take a dip.

Good luck making him happy!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB4_DESC: Hamilton Drake has hitchhiked into town! Click the button below to find out where he is and what he's doing!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB4COMING_DESC: Washed up star of (now cancelled) Sci-Fi show 'Eye of Uranus' Hamilton Drake is coming to Vegas in five hours time to try and get some free publicity at the Montys ceremony. He's also here to gamble away the last dregs of his fortune. Poor guy: it all seems to have gone south for him. Anyway, while he's in town he'll be looking for theater, clothing, somewhere to work out (got to stay in shape, man...), somewhere to relax, and by God any kind of gambling whatsoever. Let's hope he gets lucky, eh?
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB5_DESC: Tia Jackson has just flown into Las Vegas! Click the button below to find out where she is and what she's up to!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB5COMING_DESC: Miss Tia Jackson is on her way back to the Strip! She'll be here in seven hours time, and she's hoping to win a Monty for her role in hit movie 'The Fire Within'. While she's eagerly awaiting her big night, she's going to be looking to spend some money on expensive clothing, dancing and new earrings. She's also partial to a little flutter from time to time, and she also needs help keeping her body beautiful. Don't forget: she'll also be looking for somewhere wonderful to stay!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB6_DESC: The Queen of Pop is in town! Click the link below to see what she's getting up to!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB6COMING_DESC:
Oops, she did it again&! Ms. Samantha Banks has returned to Las Vegas in time for the Montys award ceremony! She's one of America's biggest performing artistes, loved by millions of young men and women all over the world, and she'll be here in six hours time! While she's here, she's going to be on the lookout for somewhere to work out, an expensive new frock (gotta look the best on the big night!), and somewhere she can get a soft drink or two. She's also really into her roller coasters, and has a fondness for the Wheel of Fortune!

Good luck making her happy!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB7_DESC: Click the link below to find out what Dandy Rivers is up to and where she can be found! Have you got what it takes to satisfy him?
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB7COMING_DESC: Dandy Rivers (Female impersonator, stand-up comic and star of hit sitcom 'Just Dandy!') is coming to town in six hours time to get in line for the Montys award ceremony! While he's here he'll be on the prowl for new frocks, a nice suit for the big night, a little theater and some expensive and exotic cocktails. He also likes to boogie!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB8_DESC: Jessica Baker has just flown into town! Click the link below to see where she is and what she's up to!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEB8COMING_DESC: She's America's best-loved model: blonde bombshell Jessica Baker! She's coming to town in five hours time to show off her new wardrobe at the Montys! If you want to make her happy, you should know that she loves craps, expensive, elegant evening wear, and pricey cocktails. She also loves to dance, and is a firm believer in the notion that diamonds are a girl's best friend...
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CELEBS_DESC: Loads more Celebrities have come to Vegas in time for the big event! Quick; take their cash!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CHEATDONE_DESC: Thanks to improved security on the Strip, the gang of super-cheats has been arrested!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CHEATDONE_NAME: Super-Cheats rounded up by local authorities!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_CHEATSPAWN_DESC: A pack of twenty super-cheats is targeting all casinos in the area. Tighten security to make sure they don't make attack your casino!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_DISPLAYEXPOSE_DESC: Place one Fireworks Display Stage on the Strip to earn a $20,000 bonus from the Nevada State Planning Department and increase your Lot's reputation by 10 points!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_EARTHCOMING_DESC: Earthmothers Inc. will be here in five hour time, and they're offering bonuses of $1,000 for each Cleaners' Department they find on a Lot, as well as $300 for each Bin.
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_ENDPEOPLE_DESC:
This is it: New Year's Eve, and the biggest party of the year! To celebrate, the world's biggest girl group Bratz have decided to bring the final show of their sell-out tour to the Strip! They'll be here in five hours time, and to make sure you get them to play at your complex all you'll need to do is build an Arena (if you haven't already got one that is)! Around 200 Bratz fans have just swarmed into town, looking for the time of their lives! These people are as follows: 

  Male Parents
  Female Parents
  Boys
  Girls
  Single Girls
  Single Guys
  Skater Dudes
  Skater Chicks

 Make sure you give them what they want!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_FINALE_DESC: You've done it: Bratz are doing their show right here, and the countdown to the New Year has begun! When midnight comes, make sure you're watching the sky!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_FINALE2_DESC: You've done it: Bratz are doing their show right here, and the countdown to the New Year has begun!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNOARENA_DESC: As you've failed to build an Arena in which the ceremony could be held, the Montys' organisers have decided not to bring the event to your Lot. You've failed this scenario.
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNOARENA_NAME: The Montys can't come to your Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNOARENAUPGRADE_DESC: As you've failed to make the necessary upgrade to your Arena in time, the Montys award ceremony cannot be held on your Lot. You've failed this scenario!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNOARENAUPGRADE_NAME: The Montys can't come to your Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNOCOFFEEBAR_DESC: As you haven't built a soda bar, the organizers of the Montys have decided not to bring the ceremony to your Lot. These Hollywood types need their caffeine! Unfortunately, this oversight has cost you the scenario.
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNOCOFFEEBAR_NAME: The Montys won't be coming to your Lot
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNOENTERTAINMENTSUITE: Because you haven't built an Entertainer's Office, the organizers of the Montys have decided not to bring the ceremony to your Lot. Unfortunately, this oversight has cost you the scenario.
The Montys won't be coming to your Lot
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNOLARGEHOTEL_DESC: Because you've neglected to build a Large Hotel, the Montys' ceremony organizers have decided not to bring the event to your Lot. This oversight means that you have failed the scenario.
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNOLARGEHOTEL_NAME: The Montys won't be coming to your Lot
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNONIGHTCLUB3_DESC: As you haven't built a Ball Room, the organizers of the Montys have decided not to bring the ceremony to your Lot. These Hollywood types need somewhere to party after the ceremony! Unfortunately, this has cost you the scenario.
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNONIGHTCLUB3_NAME: The Montys won't be coming to your Lot
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNONIGHTCLUB4_DESC: As you haven't built an Exclusive Nightclub, the organizers of the Montys have decided not to bring the ceremony to your Lot. These Hollywood types need somewhere to party after the ceremony! Unfortunately, this has cost you the scenario.
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNONIGHTCLUB4_NAME: The Montys won't be coming to your Lot
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNORESTAURANT_DESC: Because you've failed to build an a la carte restaurant, the Montys' organizers have decided to pass over your Lot and take their business elsewhere. This small oversight has cost the scenario!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNORESTAURANT_NAME: The Montys won't be coming to your Lot
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNOSIGNLARGE_DESC: As you've failed to place a Large Sign on your Lot, the organizers feel that you haven't done enough to promote the event. This oversight has cost you the scenario. Do you want to try again?
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_LOSTNOSIGNLARGE_NAME: The Montys won't be coming to your Lot
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_MONTYSEXPOSE_DESC: It's the day of the ceremony! If you've managed to make all the people types who are after this event happy, then the Montys should come to your Arena. The Montys event will last from 8pm tonight till 2am the following morning. Succeed in getting the event to your Lot, and the organizers will pay you one million dollars! Pretty awesome, huh?
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_NOFINALE_DESC: Because you failed to build an Arena, Bratz have been forced to take their show somewhere else. That's a shame; it would've been something to see! But never mind, it's still the biggest night of the year!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_ARENA_DESC: It's the highlight of the show business calendar, the Annual Awards for Cinematic Achievement - the Montys! This year, they're coming to Las Vegas, and the organizers are looking for a suitable venue for the ceremony. By the end of Day Seven, you'll need to have built on Arena in order to qualify for the show, but be warned: your rivals will also be building Arenas and doing their utmost to get the ceremony to their property. Stay sharp!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_ARENADONE_DESC: Good work; you built an Arena before the deadline! Now let's see if you can get the Montys to come to your complex for the show...
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_ARENALOSE_DESC: You didn't build an Arena before the deadline, which means this scenario has been failed. Tough luck, chum! Maybe you could give it another go?
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_ARENAWON_DESC:
That's it! All objectives for this scenario have been beaten, and this scenario has been completed!

Well, your work here is pretty much done! You've won the game, baby; you're the most successful entrepreneur on the Strip! How about that?

At least one large sign

  Celebrities
  'Whales'

The upcoming Montys ceremony will be bringing loads of these onto the Strip over the next few days, and they're all looking for the most expensive goods and services, so get going!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_GUESTSDONE_DESC: Great work; you were the first Vegas entrepreneur to get 2,000 prestigious guests to visit your property! But you're not quite there yet, there's still work to do before you reach the end!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_GUESTSLOSEP2_DESC: Tough luck, kid, Lucas Graves has succeeded in getting 2,000 prestigious guests to his Lot ahead of his rivals: including you.  He really is a tricky customer! This means you've failed the scenario; maybe you'd like to give it another go?
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_GUESTSLOSEP3_DESC: Oof! Damien G. West has succeeded in getting 2,000 prestigious guests to his Lot ahead of his rivals, including you. This means you've failed the scenario!  Maybe you'd like to give it another go?
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_GUESTSLOSEP4_DESC: Unlucky! Derren Languid has succeeded in getting 2,000 prestigious guests to his Lot ahead of his rivals, including you. This means you've failed the scenario... maybe you'd like to give it another go?
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_GUESTSLOSEP5_DESC: Tough break! Michel Dupont has succeeded in getting 2,000 prestigious guests to his Lot ahead of his rivals, including you. This means you've failed the scenario... maybe you'd like to give it another go?
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_GUESTSWON_DESC:
That's it! All objectives for this scenario have been beaten, and this scenario has been completed!

Well, your work here is pretty much done! You've won the game, baby; you're the most successful entrepreneur on the Strip! How about that?

    GAME OVER, MAN
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_MONTYS_DESC:
In eight days time, the biggest event on the show business calendar is coming to Las Vegas: the Annual Award for Cinematic Excellence, otherwise known as the Montys! If you succeed in getting this event to your property you'll find that hundreds of people are drawn to your businesses and attractions! Not only that, but the event's organizers will pay you ONE MILLION DOLLARS for allowing them to stage their event on your property. Pretty groovy, right? To nab this event, just do your best to complete all the other objectives for this scenario!

Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_MONTYSLOSE_DESC: You didn't do enough to get the Montys onto your property! That's a real shame, as it would have been pretty awesome, and $1,000,000 isn't to be sniffed at. But no problem: you've still got a shot at completing the scenario, and there's a good chance that another major event will be right around the corner...
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_MONTYSWON_DESC: Ace job! You succeeded in staging the Montys on your property! Expect hundreds of tourists, celebrities and VIPs to come to your entertainment complex for the show business event of the year! As if that wasn't enough, the organizers of the ceremony have awarded you the grand sum of $1,000,000! Woo hoo!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_SIGN_DESC: Build a Large Sign and you'll receive a $15,000 bonus from the Nevada State Planning Department, as well as an increase of 20 points on your Lot's reputation!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_SIGNWON_DESC: Ace job! The NSPD are giving you $15,000 for your sterling work. And the reputation of your Lot has jumped by 20 points! Great!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_WEDDING_DESC:
'The Mighty' Samson Stone and Ms. Joyce Withers (nee Crosby) are to be wed in six hours! To get this event to your property, make sure you have a wedding chapel built, as well as all those services and attractions that are to the happy couple's tastes. Joyce is after:

  Rock Bands
  Cocktails
  Cinemas
  Craps
  Clubbing
  Medium or Large Hotels

Stone is drawn to:

  Sports Book Betting
  Personal Trainers
  Health Spas
  Restaurants
  Swimming Pools
  Medium or Large Hotel

Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_WEDDINGLOSE_DESC: You failed to offer Mr. Stone and Ms. Withers what they were after, so they've decided not to take their wedding somewhere else. Next stop: Monte Carlo! Bad luck, chum. But they might be back in time for the Montys...
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_OBJ_WEDDINGWIN_DESC: Samson Stone and Joyce Withers have been married here in Las Vegas, and on your property to boot! Great work, and here's to the happy couple (Wonder how long it'll last...)
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_P2ARENA_DESC: Lucas Graves has been watching your activities very closely; he's noticed that you've built yourself an Arena, and decided to build one of his own. Watch out for this guy, he could be trouble...
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_P2HOTEL_DESC: Lucas Graves has built a Large Hotel! It's a beauty; check it out by hitting the link below!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_P3ARENA_DESC: The mad movie maker has just built himself an Arena! He's definitely making a bid to get the Montys to his Lot; what are you going to do to stop him?
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_P3HOTEL_DESC: Damien G. West has noticed that you've built a Large Hotel, and decided to build one of his own! Check it out by hitting the link below!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_P3SIGN_DESC: Mr G. West has just built himself a Large Sign! Click the link below to take a look!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_P4ARENA_DESC: Looks like Derren Languid is making a play for the Montys: he's just built himself an Arena! Click the link below to see it for yourself!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_P4HOTEL_DESC: Mr Languid has just had a Large Hotel built! Click the link below to take a look at it!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_PARTYDAMAGE_DESC: As a result of last night's festivities, all of the buildings on your property are down to 10% their optimum health! You'll need to get your repairmen out and about to fix things up!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_POWER_DESC: A lightning strike has hit the local power station! They've knocked up their prices to help pay for the problem!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_POWEREND_DESC: Extensive repairs were necessary, but the problem with the local grid has been fixed and normal electricity prices have resumed! There's a stroke of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_PUMPS_DESC: Due to some low-quality suppliers, all beer pumps in all bars on the Strip have broken down! Get your mechanics out to repair all the Bars you have on your property!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_RAT_DESC: The rats are back! All food outlets (Fast Food, Restaurant and A la Carte Restaurant) have been attacked and had their health knocked down to zero! Get your mechanics out to fix this up!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_SIGNEXPOSE_DESC: Build a Large Sign and you'll receive a $15,000 bonus from the Nevada State Planning Department, as well as an increase of 20 points on your Lot's reputation!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_STARTUPMESSAGE_DESC:
This is it: the final challenge!

In eight days time, the biggest event on the show business calendar is coming to Las Vegas: the Annual Award for Cinematic Excellence, otherwise known as the Montys! If you succeed in getting this event to your property you'll find that hundreds of people are drawn to your businesses and attractions! Not only that, but the event's organizers will pay you ONE MILLION DOLLARS for allowing them to stage their event on your property. Pretty groovy, right?

To ensure you get this big event, you're going to need to do the following:

Get 2,000 prestigious guests to visit your entertainment complex

Get 15 celebrities to visit your property by the end of Day Ten

Build an Arena

Got that? Remember, the Montys is a big event, well worth aiming for! Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_TREMOR_DESC: An earth tremor has struck the Nevada desert! All buildings have been severely damaged! Get to work repairing them, or your customers will start leaving in droves!
