ID_SCENARIO_NTS_WATER_DESC: Major drought! Well, what did you expect: we are in the middle of the desert, after all. Because of this problem, the local Water Authority has had to hike up their prices. You may be able to get around this problem with some clever building, however...
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_WEDDINGFAIL_DESC: You failed to offer Mr. Stone and Ms. Withers what they were after, so they've decided not to stage their wedding in Vegas after all. Next stop: Monte Carlo! Bad luck.
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_WEDDINGFAIL_NAME: The celebrity wedding has passed you by!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_WEDDINGWARNING_DESC:
It's the second biggest showbiz event of the season: 'The Mighty' Samson Stone and Ms. Joyce Withers (nee Crosby) are to be wed in six hours! To get this event to your Lot, make sure you have a wedding chapel built, as well as all those services and attractions that are to the happy couple's tastes. Remember, Joyce is often in the mood for rock bands, expensive booze, and the three Cs: cinema, craps and clubbing.

Stone digs on sports book betting, candlelit suppers and swimming. He'll also need to do some heavy duty working-out in preparation for the honeymoon, and also likes to be a little pampered from time to time. Remember, this couple will also be looking for somewhere to hold the ceremony...
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_WEDDINGWIN_DESC: The happy couple have been joined in holy matrimony in Las Vegas! Aahh, gives you a warm glow inside, doesn't it? No? You damn cynic!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_WEDDINGWIN_NAME: Mr. Stone and Ms. Withers have been wed!
ID_SCENARIO_NTS_WINLEVEL_DESC: You've done brilliantly; by successfully bringing the Montys award ceremony to your property, you've sealed your reputation as the most powerful, most successful entrepreneur in the whole of Las Vegas! Congratulations!
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_BUILDCASINO_DESC:
<textbox>It's about time we took a closer look at Casinos.

Casinos can be found in the Recreation  <image filename i_entertainment_big.tga>  Casinos  <image filename t_gaming.tga>  area of the construction panel. 

Place a Small Casino on your Lot.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_BUILDING_DESC:
<textbox>Well done, you've bought your first Lot!

Now let's build a Hotel for your guests. First select the Lot, then click on the Construction  <image filename i_build.tga>  icon.

Select the Infrastructure  <image filename i_infrastructure_big.tga>  Hotels  <image filename t_accom.tga>  tab and select a Small Hotel.

Use the mouse to position the Hotel in the Lot and use the space bar to rotate it.

Left click when you are happy with its placement!</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_BUILDINGINFO_DESC:
<textbox>This panel shows the day's profits and losses, and the amount currently charged per room.

The  People  <image filename i_people.tga>  icon will have information on who likes your building, and who has visited.

It is important to keep track of who visits/likes your buildings.  You may be attracting the wrong type of guest!

The Graph  <image filename i_charts_bar.tga>  icon allows you access to historical information about the hotel. 

The Info  <image filename i_info.tga>  icon will have general information about the building.

View the statistics for the Hotel by selecting these icons.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_BUILDINGINFOA_DESC:
<textbox>Your first guests have arrived!

Let's take a look at how this has effected your building.

Select the Hotel and click on the Dollar  <image filename i_finance.tga>  icon to view the sales info.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_CAMERA_DESC:
<textbox>This is a good time to experiment with the camera controls.

Click on your hotel to change to object view.

Moving the mouse whilst holding down the right mouse button will orbit the camera around the selected object.

Zoom in and out using the Page up/Page down keys, or your mouse wheel.

Moving the mouse whilst holding down the right and left mouse buttons will Pan the camera.

The camera behaves in this way regardless of view mode.

The Camera Controls Overview can be viewed via the objectives  <image filename i_objectives.tga>  panel.

Select the Lot when you are ready to move on.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_CASHIER_DESC:
<textbox>Slot machines will break down once they've filled up with coins.

A Cashier's Assistant can be called to empty them, but first you'll need a Cashiers Desk.

Place a Cashiers Desk.

Go to the Infrastructure  <image filename i_infrastructure_big.tga>  Casino Staff  <image filename t_intfac_A.tga>  area of the construction panel, select the Cashiers Desk and place one in your Casino.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_CASHVISIT_DESC: <textbox>To get a Cashier's Assistant to empty a Slot Machine, select the Slot you want to empty and click the Repair  <image filename i_mechanic.tga>  icon to call the Assistant to the machine.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_ELECTRICIAN_DESC:
<textbox>Different structures require different types of maintenance.

You'll need an Electrician to repair an Arcade or Cinema for example.

Build a Cinema and an Electricians Hut.

The Cinema is located in the Recreation  <image filename i_entertainment_big.tga>  Entertainment  <image filename t_inflnc.tga>  area of the construction panel.

Go to the Infrastructure  <image filename i_infrastructure_big.tga>  Maintenance Staff <image filename t_staff.tga>  area of the construction panel, to find the Electricians Hut.

Ensure that both buildings are connected with paths.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_ENTCASINO_DESC:
<textbox>Select the Casino you have just built.

Then, click the Enter Casino  <image filename i_enter_casino.tga>  button.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_FILTERS_DESC:
<textbox>Filters are a great way to visualize the affect your Lot has on your guests.

Select the Filters  <image filename i_filter.tga>  view.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_FILTERS2_DESC:
There are four main Filter modes.

Select Influences.
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_FILTERS3_DESC:
There are many options for viewing Affecters.

Select Noise.
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_FILTERS4_DESC:
See how the Mechanics Hut produces a lot of noise?

Click Smell to see its affect, and then Beauty!
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_FILTERS5_DESC:
<textbox>There doesn't appear to be any highlights for Beauty on your Lot.

Let's build a Tree to see how it influences the Beauty Filter.

Go to the Scenery  <image filename i_scenery_big.tga>  Trees  <image filename t_gardens.tga>  area of the construction panel, and place a Tree close to the Hotel.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_FILTERS6_DESC:
<textbox>If the Beauty Filter is still activated you should see a green glow around the Tree.

Beauty objects increase the attractiveness of your Lot and make guests more likely to stay.

Let's go back to Filter  <image filename i_filter.tga>  view.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_FILTERS7_DESC:
Let's take a look at another Filter type.

Select Objects, then the 'State of Repair' button.
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_FILTERS8_DESC:
<textbox>The colors of the buildings will now range from white, through yellow to black.

A white building will be in good state of repair.
A yellow building in a medium state.
A black building is in a poor state of repair.

This is a great way to get a quick idea of which buildings require a mechanic or electrician.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_FLOOR_DESC:
<textbox>Inside a Casino it is possible to raise and lower the floor.

To do this, select the Edit Floor button  <image filename i_decor.tga>  and then the Floor Height tab.  <image filename i_floors.tga>
Try raising some floor now!</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_FLOOR2_DESC:
<textbox>First, select an empty area of floor. The selected area will appear gray.

Click the raise floor icon  <image filename i_raise.tga>  to raise the selected area.

Floors can be constantly raised and lowered without cost.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_INTINTRO_DESC:
<textbox>Interiors function in much the same way as exteriors.

You will need to create facilities, employ staff and place scenery to make your casino attractive to guests.

Interiors also have some unique features. Let's take a look at some now.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_LASTOBJECTIVE_DESC:
Complete the level by increasing the number of visitors on your Lot by 50.

More attractions are available in the building tree.

Build up your Lot to draw in more guests!
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_LOTPURCHASE_DESC:
<textbox>To buy this Lot click the Buy  <image filename i_buy.tga>  icon in the panel below.

You will be given a choice of themes for your Lot. Choose one of the available themes, then click on the Accept  <image filename i_tick.tga>  icon.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_MECHANIC_DESC:
<textbox>Over time your structures will start to break down.

This happens through age and usage.

To maintain a good state of repair, structures need to be serviced by a Mechanic.

Go to the Infrastructure  <image filename i_infrastructure_big.tga>  Maintenance Staff  <image filename t_staff.tga>  area of the construction panel to place a Mechanics Hut.

Ensure that the structure is connected via a path!</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_MECHANIC2_DESC:
<textbox>To get the Mechanic to visit the Hotel you need to select the Hotel and click the Repair  <image filename i_mechanic.tga>  icon.

This will call a mechanic to your Hotel.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_BUILD_DESC:
<textbox>Build a Hotel for your guests. Select the Lot, then click on the construction  <image filename i_build.tga>  icon.

Select the Infrastructure  <image filename i_infrastructure_big.tga>  Hotels  <image filename t_accom.tga>  tab and select a Small Hotel.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_BUILDCASINO_DESC: <textbox>Casinos can be found in the Recreation  <image filename i_entertainment_big.tga>  Casinos  <image filename t_gaming.tga>  area of the construction panel.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_CAMERA_DESC:
<textbox>Moving the mouse whilst holding down the right mouse button will orbit the camera around the selected object.

Zoom in and out using the Page up/Page down keys, or your mouse wheel.

Moving the mouse whilst holding down the right and left mouse buttons will Pan the camera.

The camera behaves in this way regardless of view mode.

Select the Lot when you are ready to move on.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_CAMERA2_DESC: Practice using the camera, then select the Lot to move on.
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_CASHIER_DESC:
<textbox>Place a Cashiers Desk.

 Go to the Infrastructure  <image filename i_infrastructure_big.tga>  Casino Staff  <image filename t_intfac_A.tga>  area of the construction panel, select the Cashiers Desk and place one in your casino.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_CASHVISIT_DESC: <textbox>To get a Cashier's Assistant to empty a slot machine, select the Slot you want to empty and click the Repair  <image filename i_mechanic.tga>  icon to call the Assistant to the machine.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_ELECTRICIAN_DESC:
<textbox>Build a Cinema and an Electricians Hut.

The Cinema is located in the Recreation  <image filename i_entertainment_big.tga>  Entertainment  <image filename t_inflnc.tga>  area of the construction panel.

Go to the Infrastructure  <image filename i_infrastructure_big.tga>  Maintenance Staff <image filename t_staff.tga>  area of the construction panel, to find the Electricians Hut.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_ELECTRICIAN_NAME: Build a Cinema and an Electricians Hut.
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_ENTCASINO_DESC:
<textbox>Select the Casino you want to enter.

On the right hand side of the panel select the Enter Casino  <image filename i_enter_casino.tga>  icon.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_FILTER2_DESC:
<textbox>Select the Filter  <image filename i_filter.tga>  View.

Evaluate the health of the structures using 'State of Repair'.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_FILTER2_NAME: Use Filter View to see the 'State of Repair'.
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_FILTERS_DESC:
<textbox>Build a Tree to see how it influences the beauty filter.

Go to the Scenery  <image filename i_scenery_big.tga>  Trees  <image filename t_gardens.tga>  area of the construction panel, and place a Tree close to the Hotel.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_FLOOR_DESC:
<textbox>To raise or lower a Casino floor, select the Edit Floor icon  <image filename i_decor.tga>  and then the Floor Height tab.  <image filename i_floors.tga>

Select an empty area of floor. The selected area will appear gray.

Click the raise floor icon  <image filename i_raise.tga>  to raise the selected area.

Floors can be constantly raised and lowered without cost.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_LASTOBJECTIVE_DESC:
Complete the level by increasing the number of visitors on your lot by 50.

Build up your Lot to draw in more guests!
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_MECHANIC_DESC:
<textbox>To maintain a good state of repair, structures need to be serviced by a mechanic.

Go to the Infrastructure  <image filename i_infrastructure_big.tga>  Maintenance Staff <image filename t_staff.tga>  area of the construction panel, to place a Mechanics Hut.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_MECHANIC2_DESC:
<textbox>To get the Mechanic to visit the Hotel you need to select the Hotel and click the Repair  <image filename i_mechanic.tga>  icon.

This will call a mechanic to your Hotel.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_MECHANIC2_NAME: Get the Mechanic to visit the Hotel.
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_NOISE_DESC:
<textbox>Click the Filters icon  <image filename i_filter.tga>  in the main mode menu.

Select Influences as the mode and Noise as the type.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_OBJECTIVE_DESC:
In Vega$ Make It Big! All construction takes place on an area of land referred to as a Lot.

There is only one available Lot at this time and it will become highlighted when the cursor is over it.

Left click to select the Lot.
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_OFFICE_DESC:
<textbox>Some building types can not be constructed until you have built or upgraded others.

If you try to construct a Souvenir Shop, you will find that it is dependent on a Head Office.

Construct a Head Office to unlock this part of the tree.

You can find the Head Office in the

Infrastructure  <image filename i_infrastructure_big.tga>  Offices  <image filename t_office.tga>  area of the construction panel.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_OFFICE2_DESC:
<textbox>Select the Head Office and click the Upgrade  <image filename i_upgrade.tga>  button.

This will enable you to construct retail outlets including the souvenir shop.

Build the Souvenir Shop by going to the Retail  <image filename i_retail_big.tga>  Shops  <image filename t_shops.tga>  area of the construction panel

Remember to ensure that all structure are connected with paths!</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_OFFICE2_NAME: Upgrade Head Office, build a Souvenir Shop.
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_PATHS_DESC:
<textbox>It is important to remember that people can't enter a Lot or a Building without paths. They are the glue that binds all structures together!

Create a path to connect your Small Hotel to the outer edge of the Lot, by clicking on the Construction  <image filename i_build.tga>  icon and then the Scenery  <image filename i_scenery_big.tga>  Path  <image filename t_path.tga>  tab.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_POKER_DESC:
<textbox>Place a Blackjack Table.

Tables can be found in the Gaming   <image filename i_games_big.tga>  Tables   <image filename t_tables.tga>  area of the construction panel. Place one in your Casino now.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_POKERSET_DESC:
<textbox>Select the Blackjack Table.

In the finance section  <image filename i_finance.tga>  of the panel you will see two variables, Bet Range and House Edge.

Bet Range controls the minimum and maximum bet for the table.

House Edge controls how fair you are with the betting. A higher Edge will favor the house!

Adjust the Bet Range to $10 - $25 and the House Edge to High.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_SALES_DESC:
<textbox>Your first guests have arrived!

Let's take a look at how that has effected your building

Click on the Hotel and select the Dollar  <image filename i_finance.tga>  icon to view the sales info.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_SALES2_DESC: <textbox>Select the Info  <image filename i_info.tga> icon then the People  <image filename i_people.tga> then the Graph  <image filename i_charts_bar.tga>  icon to view the Hotel's statistics. </textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_SECURITY_DESC: <textbox>Place a Security Office by going to the Infrastructure  <image filename i_infrastructure_big.tga>  Staff Buildings  <image filename t_staff.tga>  area of the construction panel.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_SECURITY2_DESC:
<textbox>The Security Officer can't watch the whole Casino.

By using a Filter you can view the area that he can cover.

Select Filter View  <image filename i_filter.tga>  then the Influences filter and then select Security Coverage.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_SECURITY3_DESC:
<textbox>Select the Security Officer by clicking on him.

In the staff panel select the move icon  <image filename i_home.tga>  then select the spot you would like to move him to.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_SLOT_DESC: <textbox>Go to the Recreation  <image filename i_games_big.tga>  Slots  <image filename t_slots.tga>  area of the construction panel, select a slot machine and place it in your Casino.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_SMELL_DESC:
<textbox>Click the Filters icon  <image filename i_filter.tga>  in the main mode menu.

Select Influences as the mode and smell as the type.

Then look at Beauty listed under smell.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OBJ_STAIRS_DESC:
<textbox>Staircases can be built to connect different floor levels together.

To place a staircase, select Build  <image filename i_build.tga>  Scenery  <image filename i_scenery_big.tga >  Stairs  <image filename t_decor.tga></textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_OFFYOUGO_DESC:
<textbox>There are many more buildings, staff, and decorating tools for you to discover. Spend some time exploring your options and you will soon be on the way to the top!

In the construction panel you can view information about a building by right clicking on its icon.

To complete this level, you'll need to increase the number of visitors on your Lot by 50.

Good luck!</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_PATHS_DESC:
<textbox>It is of vital importance that your guests can gain access to every building on your Lot.

Ensure that there is a path connecting each entrance plate of a building to another and at least one to the outer edge of the Lot.

Build a path to connect your Small Hotel to the outer edge of the Lot, by clicking on the Construction  <image filename i_build.tga>  icon and then the Scenery  <image filename i_scenery_big.tga>  Path  <image filename t_path.tga>  tab.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_PATHS2_DESC:
<textbox>It is of vital importance that your guests can gain access to every building on your Lot.

Ensure that there is a path connecting each entrance plate of a building to another and at least one to the outer edge of the Lot.

It appears that the Hotel has been placed, with its entrance plate connecting the perimeter of the Lot, so a path is not needed at this time.

Path can be found, by clicking on the Construction  <image filename i_build.tga>  icon and then the Scenery  <image filename i_scenery_big.tga>  Path  <image filename t_path.tga>  tab.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_POKER_DESC:
<textbox>Gaming tables like Blackjack come with a Croupier; they also have betting options which can be adjusted.

Place a Blackjack table.

Tables can be found in the Gaming  <image filename i_games_big.tga>  Tables  <image filename t_tables.tga>  area of the construction panel. Place one in your Casino now.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_POKERSET_DESC:
<textbox>Select the Blackjack Table.

In the finance section  <image filename i_finance.tga>  of the panel you will see two variables, Bet Range and House Edge.

Bet Range controls the minimum and maximum bet for the table.

House Edge controls how fair you are with the betting. A higher Edge will favor the house!

Adjust the Bet Range to $10 - $25 and the House Edge to High.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_SECURITY_DESC:
<textbox>Security Officers can be hired to watch over your guests; they operate out of a Security Office.

Go to the Infrastructure  <image filename i_infrastructure_big.tga>  Staff Buildings  <image filename t_staff.tga>  area of the construction panel, to place a Security Office.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_SECURITY2_DESC:
<textbox>The Security Officer can't watch the whole Casino.

By using a View Filter you can see the area that he can cover.

Select Filter View  <image filename i_filter.tga>  then the Influences filter. In the Type list, scroll down and select Security Coverage.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_SECURITY3_DESC:
<textbox>The green glow represents the area of security coverage given by the Officer.

Perhaps he could be moved to a more useful area of the Casino?

With the filter still active, select the Security Officer by clicking on him.

In the staff panel, select the move icon  <image filename i_home.tga>  then select the spot you would like to move him to. </textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_SLOT_DESC:
<textbox>Now let's place a Slot Machine.

Go to the Recreation  <image filename i_games_big.tga>  Slots  <image filename t_slots.tga>  area of the construction panel, select a Slot Machine and place it in your casino.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_STAIRS_DESC:
<textbox>Staircases can be built to connect different floor levels together.

To place a staircase, select Build  <image filename i_build.tga>  Scenery  <image filename i_scenery_big.tga >  Stairs  <image filename t_decor.tga>

Try placing one now.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_TREESTRUCTURE_DESC:
<textbox>Some building types can not be constructed until you have built or upgraded others. If you try to construct a Souvenir Shop, you will find that it is dependent on a Head Office.

Construct a Head Office to unlock this part of the tree.

Go to the Infrastructure  <image filename i_infrastructure_big.tga>  Office  <image filename t_office.tga>  area of the construction panel, to find the Head Office.

Ensure that the structure is connected via a path.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_TREESTRUCTURE2_DESC:
<textbox>Great!

Now select the Head Office and click the Upgrade   <image filename i_upgrade.tga> button.

This will enable you to construct retail outlets including the souvenir shop.

Build the Souvenir Shop by going to the Retail  <image filename i_retail_big.tga>  Shops  <image filename t_shops.tga>  area of the construction panel

Make sure that all structures are connected with paths!</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_NWS_WELCOME_DESC:
<textbox>This is Vega$: Make it Big!

Let's begin with a few tips to help you through the game's controls.

At any time you can view your objectives by clicking on the Objectives  <image filename i_objectives.tga>  icon in the top left hand panel.

The  <image filename obj_info.tga>  icon in this menu will give you further details on individual tasks.

Close this panel by clicking the Accept  <image filename i_tick.tga>  icon and use the objectives  <image filename i_objectives.tga>  menu to view your first objective.</textbox>
ID_SCENARIO_P2PRICEDROP_DESC: Chase Lanyon has noticed that you're racing ahead of the pack. Now, she can't have that, so she's decided to claw her way back to the front by dropping the prices on all of her businesses and attractions. Sneaky!
ID_SCENARIO_P3PRICEDROP_DESC: Derren Languid is starting to panic; he couldn't help but notice that you're close to the prize. So he's decided to take the plunge, and has cut the prices of all of his businesses and attractions! This could make things tricky...
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_ADORA_DESC: Countess Adora Laroche has arrived on the Strip. Click the button below to find out where she is and what she's doing!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_ADORACOMING_DESC:
...although she wouldn't be happy to hear herself referred to as a 'whale'. Regardless; the Countess Adora Laroche is coming to town in seven hours time to do a little shopping and generally live it up. She'll be looking for some nice new frocks, expensive trinkets, pricey cocktails, and works of art. She'll also want to make use of a beauty parlor, if she can find one, and has been known to dabble in a little Baccarat from time to time...

Remember: If she makes fifteen purchases from your shops and services, she'll send you a gift worth $10,000! Get to work, man!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_ADORALOSE_DESC: Adora Laroche described her experience as 'pitiful'. Don't let it bother you too much; she's like that with everyone. This does mean you've missed out on all that cash though. Oh well, easy come, easy go!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_ADORALOSE_NAME: The Countess is leaving Las Vegas
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_ADORAWIN_DESC: She described the service she found there as 'more than adequate', quite a compliment from the ravishing Ms. Laroche. She's rewarded with you a $10,000 check; pretty snazzy!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_ADORAWIN_NAME: The Countess is leaving Las Vegas
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_CEMENTEND_DESC: That's it for Max Delaney's cement sale! He hopes you made the most of his generosity!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_CEMENTSTART_DESC: Crazy Max Delaney's Construction Company has slashed the cost of cement for the next day! All building costs are reduced by 50% for twenty-four hours!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_DANDY_DESC: Mr Dandy Rivers has come to town. Is your shopping complex ready for him? Her?
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_DANDYCOMING_DESC: Dandy Rivers (Female impersonator, stand-up comic and star of hit sitcom 'Just Dandy!') is coming to town in six hours time for a big show. Make him/her happy, and he'll tip you to the tune of $8,000! While he's here he'll be on the prowl for new frocks, a nice new suit, a little theater and some expensive and exotic cocktails. He also likes to boogie!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_DANDYLOSE_DESC: Oh dear. Mr Rivers has not had a tremendous time in Las Vegas, and has decided to leave. Next time, he's going to take himself off to Paris! No $8,000 bonus for you, sadly.
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_DANDYWIN_DESC: Dandy says: 'What a marvelous time I've had at your shopping complex! You've really made my day. By way of thank you, here's a signed photo of my good self. Oh, and $8,000. Don't spend it all at once, honey!' Wow, what a swell gal! Um.
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_DANDYWIN_NAME: Dandy Rivers is leaving Las Vegas!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_FASHIONHERE_DESC: Sweeet Thing have arrived on the Strip! Are you ready for them?
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_FASHIONPLAYER1WON_DESC: Well done, you've succeeded in attracting the world's largest fashion label to your property! Your Lot will be more attractive to shoppers for the next 48 hours!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_FASHIONPLAYER1WON_NAME: Sweeet Thing have come to your Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_FASHIONPLAYER2WON_DESC: Unlucky! The world's premier fashion label have decided to take their event to a rival's Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_FASHIONPLAYER2WON_NAME: Sweeet Thing have taken their show to Grace Morley-Jones' Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_FASHIONPLAYER3WON_DESC: Unlucky! The world's premier fashion label have decided to take their event to a rival's Lot! Mr. DuPont is delighted!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_FASHIONPLAYER3WON_NAME: Sweeet Thing have taken their show to Michel DuPont's Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_FASHIONPLAYER4WON_DESC: Bad luck! The world's premier fashion label have decided to take their event to a rival's Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_FASHIONPLAYER4WON_NAME: Sweeet Thing have taken their show to Derren Languid's Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_FASHIONWARNING_DESC: Major fashion label Sweeet Thing wants to launch their new range in Vegas. They're looking for a resort to host it, which has at least five shops of any type, an arena with Fashion Show upgrade, and a large hotel to stay at. They'll be here in exactly eight days, and will stay for a further two. If you successfully attract them to your Lot, your Lot will become more attractive to shoppers for those days!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_HEALTHFINEBINEXCLUDED_D: You've been fined %d because %d of your buildings didn't make the grade! Unlucky!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_HEALTHFINEBININCLUDED_D: You've been fined $%d for having no bins on your property, and because %d of your buildings didn't make the grade. Bad luck!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_HEALTHFINEJUSTBIN_DESC: You've built no bins on your property, so for that the Health and Safety Bureau are going to fine you $%d. Bad luck, but you'll know for next time!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_HEALTHNOFINE_DESC: The Health and Safety Bureau have found no problems with any of your buildings! Well, alright!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_HEALTHNOFINE_NAME: HSB give you the thumbs up!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_HEALTHOKAY_DESC: The Health and Safety Bureau have found no problems with any of your buildings! Good work!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_HEALTHOKAY_NAME: HSB give you the thumbs up!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_HEALTHWARNING_DESC: Inspectors from the Health and Safety Bureau are coming into town in one day to inspect your facilities. Make sure you've put down adequate bins for your customers' trash, and that all of your shops and services are fully repaired. Any buildings found at 0% health will incur a fine of $600 each. If no bins are found on your property, that's an immediate $2,000 fine!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_ADORA_DESC:
The Countess Adora Laroche is coming to town to do a little shopping and generally live it up. Here's what she's after:

  Women's Clothing
  Jewelry
  Cocktails
  Art Galleries
  Baccarat Tables
  Beauty Parlors
  High Roller Suites

If she makes fifteen purchases from your shops and services, she'll send you a gift worth $10,000!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_BIGFIGHT_DESC:
Big news: the boxing match of the Century - 'The Mighty' Samson Stone vs. Big Johnny Cage - is coming to Las Vegas in 24 hours, and you've got a shot at staging it! To win this prestigious event onto your property you'll need to build an Arena, and all of the business types that the boxing fans are looking for. The following people are going to be on the lookout for boxing:

  Businessmen
  Hardcore Gamblers
  Male Parents
  Single Guys
  Retired Men
  Sad Drunks
  Bikers
  Biker Babes\ Male High Rollers
 Boxers (Samson Stone and Johnny Cage)

You're going to need to get the highest reputation with these people types if you want to win the event to your Lot. Good luck!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_DANDY_DESC:
Dandy Rivers (Female impersonator, stand-up comic and star of hit sitcom 'Just Dandy!') is coming to town for a big show. Make him/her happy, and he'll tip you to the tune of $8,000! While he's here, she'll be looking for some of the following:

  Women's Clothing
  Men's Clothing
  Cocktails
  Theaters
  Discos
  Medium or Large Hotels

Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_ENVIRGROUP_DESC: Environmental group Earthmothers is coming to the Strip! They're currently handing out cash prizes for those Lots which are doing the most to keep Nevada clean; if you've got two bins and a Cleaners' Department on your property, you'll receive a $3,000 award! Jings!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_EXCLUSIVESALES_DESC:
Here's a new objective for you to tackle: by the end of Day Ten, make 400 'Exclusive' sales! That's any sales made from the following business types:

  Jewelry Stores
  Art Galleries
  Hair Salons
  Beauty Parlors
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_EXCLUSIVESALESDONE_:
Good work! You've made 400 'exclusive' sales before the deadline! A consortium of businessmen who've been in town for the last two days have decided to send a gift worth $6,000 to your office. Excellent!

But there's still work to be done, so you can't rest easy just yet!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_EXCLUSIVESALESLOSE_: Bad luck; you didn't manage to make 400 'exclusive' sales by the deadline. This also means you've failed the scenario over all. Maybe you'd like to give it another shot?
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_EXCLUSIVESALESWON_D:
Excellent! You've made 400 sales from your 'exclusive' businesses! A consortium of businessmen who've been in town for the last two days have decided to send a gift worth $6,000 to your office. Excellent!

That's the final objective completed, and the scenario roundly beaten. Good work!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_FAMILYSALES_DESC:
Here's another objective you'll need to take on if you want to complete this scenario: make 250 sales from your family oriented Retail outlets by the end of Day Five! 'Family' business types are anything from the following list:

  Travel Agents
  Men's Clothing Stores
  Women's Clothing Stores
  Souvenir Shops
  Pawn Brokers
  Magic Shops
  Creches

Good luck!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_FAMILYSALESDONE_DES:
Good work! You've managed to make 250 family-oriented Retail sales before the deadline! As a reward for services rendered, you've been given $2,000 - excellent!

That's one objective beaten, but here's a new one for you to take on!

By the end of Day Ten, make 400 'exclusive' sales! That's anything from the following business types:

  Jewelry Stores
  Art Galleries
  Hair Salons
  Beauty Parlors

Got that? OK, get to work!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_FAMILYSALESLOSE_DES: Bad luck; you failed to make 250 'family' sales before the deadline. You know what this means: you've lost the objective and the scenario. Man, that's tough. You wanna try again?
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_FAMILYSALESWON_DESC:
Good work! You've managed to make 250 family-oriented Retail sales before the deadline! As a reward for services rendered, you've been given $2,000; excellent!

That's one objective beaten, but here's a new one for you to take on: by the end of Day Ten, make 400 'exclusive' sales! That's anything from the following business types:

  Jewelry Stores
  Art Galleries
  Hair Salons
  Beauty Parlors

Got that? OK, get to work!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_GAZE_DESC:
Boy band GAZE (Gerard, Adrian, Zach, Eddie) is coming to town, and they're looking for somewhere to play their next big gig. If you want to get GAZE to play on your Lot, you'll need to build an Arena, as well as all of the business and facility types the GAZE fans are looking for. People who will want to see GAZE are as follows:

  Female Parents
  Girls
  Single Girls
  Hen Party Guests

If you manage to get the boy band to play on your Lot, they'll act as a massive draw to the people types listed above, and their presence will guarantee you make mucho moolah!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_HEALTHEXECS_DESC: A pack of officers from the Health and Safety Executive are heading for the Strip! They'll levy $600 fines for any building found to be at 0% health, and if they find no bins on your Lot, that's an immediate $2,000 fine! Don't get caught out!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_SALES_DESC: Make thirty sales by noon on Day Three and you'll win the neighboring Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_SHOP_DESC:
Be the first Vegas tycoon to make 3,000 retail sales! That's sales from any of the businesses to be found in the Shops and Services sections of the retail buildings selection.

Good luck!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_SHOPDONE_DESC: Yes! You succeeded in making 3,000 Retail sales before your rivals. But there's still work to be done, so there's no time to rest!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_SHOPLOSEP2_DESC: With a sly grin, Ms. Grace Morley-Jones has successfully made 3,000 Retail sales ahead of her rivals. This means you've lost this objective and the scenario overall! Commiserations chum; why not give it another go?
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_SHOPLOSEP3_DESC:
Bad luck; Michel Dupont has succeeded in making 3,000 Retail sales before you. To celebrate, he's holding a huge party! But you... can't come. Sorry about that.

As if that wasn't bad enough, this also means you've failed the scenario. Why not have another go?
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_SHOPLOSEP4_DESC: Derren Languid made 3,000 Retail sales ahead of his rivals, and he's delighted! Bad news for you though; this objective has been failed and the scenario itself has also been lost. Why not have another go?
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_SHOPWON_DESC: Good work; you were the first Vegas tycoon to make 3,000 retail sales! That's the final objective beaten, and the scenario complete! Excellent!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_WEDDING_DESC: Make 20 'sales' from your Wedding Chapel, and you'll receive a free endorsement from the Almighty Himself: God! This will increase the reputation of the Wedding Chapel by 100 points, add 100 points to the reputation of your Jewelry Store and add 40 points to your Lot's reputation!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_WEDDINGWON_DESC: God loves your work! The reputation of your Lot has shot through the roof! Your Wedding Chapel has had its reputation increased by 100 points, and if you've got a Jewelry Store that too has seen its reputation increased by 100. Hallelujah!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_OBJ_YOURSHOP_DESC: Yourshop magazine are in town to review the shopping facilities available here. They'll be in town for 24 hours, at the end of which time they're going to reward the player with the most popular shopping facilities with a $10,000 prize. Also, the winner will get a glowing review in the magazine, and an instant 30 point increase on their Lot's reputation. Make sure your facilities are the best!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_P2JEWLERYSTORE_DESC: Grace Morley-Jones has built a Jewelry Store. Ahh, so shiny! Click the link below to take a look at it!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_P3CASINO_DESC: Michel Dupont has built himself a dinky little Casino. Check it out by clicking the link below!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_P3STORE_DESC: Michel Dupont has noticed that you've built a Jewelry Store, and has decided to build one of his own. Take a look at it by clicking the link below!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_PLAYER1WON_DESC: You've successfully got 3,000 shoppers to spend their money at your shops! Congratulations!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_PLAYER2WON_DESC: The Wealthy Widow has succeeded in making 3,000 sales! She can scarcely contain her glee!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_PLAYER2WON_NAME: Grace Morley-Jones has won the scenario!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_PLAYER3WON_DESC: The Fashion Impresario has succeeded in making 3,000 sales! He's over the moon!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_PLAYER3WON_NAME: Michel Dupont has won the scenario!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_PLAYER4WON_DESC: The Celebrity Photographer has succeeded in making 3,000 sales. He's surprised and delighted!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_PLAYER4WON_NAME: Derren Languid has won the scenario!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_RATATTACK_DESC: A plague of rats has swept into the Strip; your hotels and food outlets immediately get knocked down to 10% health. You'll need to use mechanics to repair these buildings!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_SALES_DESC: The Nevada State Planning Department have agreed that, if you can prove your worth as a business tycoon, they will GIVE you the neighboring Lot. Just make thirty retail sales by noon on Day Three, and the Lot is yours!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_SALESLOST_DESC: You've failed to make thirty sales in the last two days, and the Nevada State Planning Department have retracted their offer on the neighboring Lot. However, as a concession, they have dropped the Lot's price considerably...
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_SALESWON_DESC: Well done; you've made thirty-plus sales, and the Nevada State Planning Department have agreed to give you the neighboring Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_STARTUPMESSAGE_DESC:
Everyone loves to shop, right? Well, your job this time round is to exploit that fact to its fullest!

First of all, make sure you're the first Vegas entrepreneur to make 3,000 Retail sales. That's anything from the Shops and Services categories within the retail selection of buildings.

You're also going to need to make 250 sales from any family-oriented Retail outlets by the end of Day Five. That's anything sold from the following businesses:

  Travel Agents
  Men's Clothing Stores
  Women's Clothing Stores
  Souvenir Shops
  Pawn Brokers
  Magic Shops
  Creches

But that's not all! There are other challenges to come before the scenario is through, wait and see...

You're starting the scenario with one Lot already owned. It's not very big, and it's got a few buildings on it already, so you'll need to branch out into other Lots!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_STARTUPMESSAGE_NAME: Scenario Eight - Shop Till You Drop!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_STORMSTRIKE_DESC: One of your buildings has been struck by a bolt from the blue! Its health has been reduced to zero, and it needs immediate repair!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_TREMOR_DESC: An earth tremor has struck the Nevada desert! All buildings have been severely damaged! Get to work repairing them, or your customers will start leaving in droves!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_WEDDING_DESC: Make 20 'sales' from your Wedding Chapel, and you'll receive a free endorsement from the Almighty Himself: God! This will increase the reputation of the Wedding Chapel by 100 points, add 100 points to the reputation of your Jewelry Store and add 40 points to your Lot's reputation!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_YOURSHOPPLAYER1WIN_DESC:
Excellent work; Yourshop consider your facilities the best on the Strip! Here's how the scores broke down in the end:

  Your reputation: %d
  Michel Dupont's reputation: %d
  Grace Morley-Jones' reputation: %d
  Derren Languid's reputation: %d

Great job! Yourshop have given you the $10,000 prize, as well as a glowing review in their magazine. That's 30 points on your Lot's reputation!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_YOURSHOPPLAYER2WIN_DESC:
Yow! Yourshop magazine have found that Grace Morley-Jones is offering the best shopping facilities on the Strip. Here's how the score breaks down:

  Your reputation: %d
  Grace Morley-Jones' reputation: %d
  Michel Dupont's reputation: %d
  Derren Languid's reputation: %d

This means you've lost out on the $10,000 prize and the reputation increase that would have come with this award. Tough break, kiddo.
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_YOURSHOPPLAYER3WIN_DESC:
Yourshop magazine have found that Derren Languid is offering the best shopping facilities on the Strip. Here's how the score breaks down:

  Your reputation: %d
  Grace Morley-Jones' reputation: %d
  Michel Dupont's reputation: %d
  Derren Languid's reputation: %d

This means you've lost out on the $10,000 prize and the reputation increase that would have come with this award. Tough break, kiddo.
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_YOURSHOPPLAYER4WIN_DESC: Yourshop Magazine have decided that Derren Languid is offering the best shops and services on the Strip. He's been rewarded with $10,000 cash and plaudits galore!
ID_SCENARIO_STUD_YOURSHOPWARNING_DESC: Yourshop magazine are in town to review the shopping facilities available here. They'll be in town for 24 hours, at the end of which time they're going to reward the player with the most popular shopping facilities with a $10,000 prize. Also, the winner will get a glowing review in the magazine, and an instant 30 point increase on their Lot's reputation. Make sure your facilities are the best!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_80SICON_TEXT: Eighties icon Joey Devlin has hit the Strip! He's looking for an Exclusive Nightclub where he can bust some moves for his fans, as well as all the fun and excitement he can find!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_80SICONLOSE_TEXT: You've failed to bring Joey Devlin to your property. He's looking for something a little more exciting!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_80SICONWIN_TEXT: Well done, you've got Joey Devlin onto your Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_CEMENTSHORTAGE_TEXT: Cement shortage means that construction costs go up 20% for one day. Build wisely!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_CEMENTSHORTAGEEND_TEXT: The cement shortage is over for the time being: all construction costs are back down to normal. Phew!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_CUSP_DESC: Those scumbags - sorry, 'concerned citizens' - from the Coalition of United States Parents are back in town to cause trouble. You know the drill by now: if your complex has any seedy businesses (Topless Revues, Lap Dancers and the like), those businesses will be targeted by CUSP and stop attracting customers for one day. They're likely to be in town for the next 24 hours.
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_DANCING_DESC:
The Annual Disco championship is being held nearby, so around two hundred dancers looking to get some practice in have shown up on the Strip! Any one from the following people types will be looking to 'cut a rug':

  Skater Dudes
  Skater Chicks
  'Grungy' Guys
  'Grungy' Girls
  Biker Babes.
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_DEVLIN_DESC: Mr. Devlin is on the Strip! Click on the button below to find out where he is and what he's doing!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_DEVLINCOMING_DESC:
He's bad! King of Eighties R&B Joel Devlin is coming back to the Strip in one day's time! He's probably the world's most famous man, so he's got a ton of money to spend and plenty of time on his hands. He's after a bit of this, right: soft drinks, some kind of thrill-ride, video games, fast food... oh, and he also LOVES magic. You'll also need to build him somewhere to stay.

Make him happy and he'll send you a gift worth some $20,000, and increase the reputation of one of your Lots by 40 points. Go get him!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_ENVIRCOMING_DESC: Environmental group Earthmothers is coming to the Strip in three hours time! They're currently handing out cash prizes for those Lots which are doing the most to keep Nevada clean; if you've got two bins and a Cleaners' Department on your property, you'll receive a $3,000 award!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_ENVIRGROUPPLAYER1_TEXT: They're very pleased with how environmentally aware you seem to be. Keep up the good work!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_ENVIRGROUPPLAYER2_TEXT: They're delighted with her environmental awareness, and have given her the $3,000 incentive!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_ENVIRGROUPPLAYER3_TEXT: They're delighted with his environmental awareness, and have given him the $3,000 incentive!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_ENVIRGROUPPLAYER3_TITLE: Earthmothers have rewarded Damien G. West
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_ENVIRGROUPPLAYER4_TEXT: They're delighted with his environmental awareness, and have given him the $3,000 incentive!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_ENVIRGROUPWARNING_TEXT: Environmental group Earthmothers are in town. They want to see at least one Cleaners' Department, as well as plenty of bins, trees and pot plants. Those Lots which perform the best will receive a $3,000 incentive to keep up the good work. They'll be in town for 24 hours!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_ENVIRGROUPWARNING_TITLE: Earthmothers have come to Las Vegas!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_FIGHTWARNING_DESC:
Big news: the boxing match of the Century - 'The Mighty' Samson Stone vs. Big Johnny Cage - is coming to Las Vegas in 24 hours, and you've got a shot at staging it! To win this prestigious event onto your property you'll need to build an Arena, and all of the business types that the boxing fans are looking for. The following people are going to be on the lookout for boxing:

  Businessmen
  Hardcore Gamblers
  Male Parents
  Single Guys
  Retired Men
  Sad Drunks
  Bikers
  Biker Babes\ Male High Rollers
 Boxers (Samson Stone and Johnny Cage)

You're going to need to get the highest reputation with these people types if you want to win the event to your property. Good luck!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_GAZECOMING_DESC:
Boy band GAZE (Gerard, Adrian, Zach, Eddie) is coming to town in one day, and they're looking for somewhere to play their next big gig. If you want to get GAZE to play at your entertainment complex, you'll need to build an Arena, as well as all of the business and facility types the GAZE fans are looking for. Here are some of the people who will be looking for GAZE:

  Female Parents 
  Girls
  Single Girls
  Hen Party Guests

If you manage to get the boy band to play at your entertainment complex, they'll act as a massive draw to the people types listed above, and their presence will guarantee you mucho moolah!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_GOLFER_DESC: Danny Jackson has flown into town. Are you ready for the Swingmaster General?
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_GOLFERCOMING_DESC:
Professional golfer Danny 'Swingmaster General' Jackson is coming to town in six hours! He's got plenty of time to kill between tournaments and is absolutely loaded. While he's on the Strip, he'll be looking to do a little sports book betting, working out and swimming. He's also partial to the occasional low-calorie soft drink (got to stay trim in his line of work, y'know), and he LOVES the movies.

Make him happy and he'll tip you to the tune of $8,000, as well as increasing the reputation of your Lot by 20 points!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_MORALGROUP_TEXT: The Coalition of United States Parents has arrived in Vegas! Expect trouble!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_MORALGROUPWARNING_TEXT: At 12pm today, moral pressure group the Coalition of United States Parents will arrive in Vegas! They're here to force the closure of the less reputable businesses in the region, and they'll try and achieve this by walking around any Lots featuring these business types and bothering the guests. Expect any topless revue shows, strippers etc. to have a much harder time finding custom while these guys are in town!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_ADVERTISING_DESC: By the end of Day Three, spend $8,000 on promoting your Casino complex. Remember, you can do this by building anything from the Signs, Statues and Displays section of the building panel below. Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_ADVERTISING_DONE_DE: Good work; you've managed to spend $8,000 on promoting your Casino complex by the deadline. But there's no time to hang around; you've still got work to do if you want to complete the scenario!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_ADVERTISING_LOSE_DE: Bad luck; you've failed to spend $8,000 on promoting your Casino complex by the deadline. This means you've failed the scenario, man. But don't feel too blue; you can always try again, right?
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_ADVERTISING_WON_DES: Great job; you've built $8,000 worth of publicity for your complex by the deadline. That's the final objective beaten and the scenario complete! Well, alright!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_ARENAVENUE_DESC: By the end of Day Six, make sure you've built one Arena and one Live Music Venue. This won't be cheap, but you do have a choice here: you can choose to tackle this objective or try and beat the next one along. Either way, best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_ARENAVENUE_NAME: An Arena and a Live Music Venue
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_ARENAVENUEDONE_DESC: You've succeeded in building an Arena and a Live Music Venue before the deadline. Great job! But there's still work to be done if you want to beat this scenario...
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_ARENAVENUELOSE_DESC: Bad luck; you failed to get that Arena and Live Music Venue up before the deadline. But not to worry! There's other work you can do to complete the scenario; keep going!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_ARENAVENUEWON_DESC: Excellent! You've built an Arena and a Live Music Venue before the deadline. Nightlife magazine are delighted with the work that you've done, and are awarding you the Gold Star for entertainment excellence! Scenario completed; good job!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_BIGFIGHTLOSENOARENA: No Arena on your Lot? The Fight Night organizers have decided they're going to have to take their big event somewhere else. Tough luck, kid, but look on the bright side; there's bound to be another big event for you to nab sooner or later...
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_BIGFIGHTLOSEP2_DESC: Looks like Grace Morley-Jones was offering the best facilities to the sports fans on the Strip, so the Fight Night organizers have decided to take the Bout of the Century to her Lot instead of yours. Bad luck; you've missed out on this pretty major event, but there should be another one along quite shortly...
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_BIGFIGHTLOSEP3_DESC: Looks like Damien G. West was offering the best facilities to the boxing fans on the Strip, so the Fight Night organizers have decided to take the Bout of the Century to his complex instead of yours. Bad luck; you've missed out on this pretty major event, but there might be another one along quite shortly...
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_BIGFIGHTLOSEP4_DESC: Hal Harding was offering the best facilities to the boxing fans on the Strip, so the Fight Night organizers have decided to take the Bout of the Century to his Lot instead of yours. Unlucky; you've missed out on this pretty major event, but there might be another one along quite shortly...
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_BIGFIGHTWIN_DESC: Excellent! You've succeeded in getting the fight of the Century to come your property! Expect hordes of fight fans to swamp to your property, looking for some action!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_DEVLIN_DESC:
He's probably the world's most famous man, crown prince of Eighties pop Joel Devlin, and he's coming to the Strip in one day! He's got lots of money and is looking to have the time of his life! This is what he's looking for:

  Themed Rides
  Roller coasters
  Arcades
  Fast Food Restaurants
  Magic Shows
  Magic Shops
  Medium or Large Hotels

An expensive prospect, no doubt about it; but if you make him happy, he'll give you $20,000, and his presence will raise your Lot's reputation by 40 points!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_DEVLINLOSE_DESC: Mr. Devlin's management would like it to be known that he had a pretty feeble time at your entertainment complex, and will certainly think twice about coming back to Sin City. Shame; you could really have used that $20,000, and the 40 reputation points would have been darn handy as well. Never mind, onward and upward!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_DEVLINWIN_DESC: Mr. Devlin's management would like it be known that he had a thrilling time checking out all your shops and attractions. Here's $20,000 to give your bank account a boost. Not just that, but your Lot's reputation has leapt up by 40 points! Great job, there!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_ENVIRGROUPNOBINS_DE: Earthmothers have decided not to give you that $3,000 cash prize, as you hadn't built enough bins by the deadline. Never mind!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_ENVIRGROUPNORP_DESC: Earthmothers have decided not to give you their $3,000 cash prize, as you didn't build a Cleaners' Department by the deadline. Shame!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_ENVIRGROUPWIN_DESC: Excellent! Earthmothers are delighted to find that you're doing your utmost to make the world a better place! Here's $3,000 of their cash!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_GAZELOSENOARENA_DES: Because you didn't build an Arena for the boy band of the moment to play in, they've decided to take their show somewhere else. Well, wherever they're going, they won't be bringing all that business to your Lot now, that's for sure. Better luck next time, pal!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_GAZELOSEP2_DESC: Grace Morley-Jones offered services and facilities that were more appealing to GAZE fans, so the band has decided to take their show to her Lot instead of yours. Tough break: this means you've lost out on all the cash that the GAZE fans would have brought to your shops and attractions!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_GAZELOSEP3_DESC: It turns out Damien G. West was offering the best services and facilities for the GAZE fans on the Strip. This means that the band has decided to take their show to his Lot instead of yours. Bad luck; this means you've lost out on all the cash and prestige this event would have brought you!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_GAZELOSEP4_DESC: Looks like Hal Harding offered services and facilities that were more appealing to GAZE fans, so the band's management has decided that the show is going to be held on his property instead of yours. Unlucky; this means you've missed out on all the cash and prestige this event would have brought you!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_GAZEWIN_DESC: Excellent work: GAZE's management have decided to bring the show to your Lot! Get ready to be swamped by teenage girls, mothers and single women!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_GOLFER_DESC:
Professional golfer Danny 'Swingmaster General' Jackson is coming to town! He's got plenty of time to kill between tournaments and is absolutely loaded. While he's on the Strip, he'll be looking for the following:

  Sports Book
  Sodas
  Personal Trainers
  Swimming Pools
  Cinemas
  Medium or Large Hotel

Make him happy and he'll tip you $8,000, as well as increasing the reputation of your Lot by 20 points!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_GOLFERLOSE_DESC: Hmm, it doesn't look like Mr. Jackson had the best time when he visited your property. It's doubtful that he'll be giving you the $8,000 that was promised, and your Lot's reputation hasn't improved much either. Shame!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_GOLFERLOSE_NAME: Danny Jackson is out of here!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_GOLFERWIN_DESC: Well, alright! Mr. Jackson on the Strip, and it's largely thanks to you! Here's a signed golf bag by way of congratulations, and it's stuffed with cash (looks like about $8,000)! Your Lot's reputation has leapt up by 20 points!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_LOT_DESC: To complete this scenario, you'll need to have bought two Lots on the Strip by the end of Day Ten. Complete this, plus the other objectives, and that's this scenario complete. Best of luck, kiddo!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_LOTDONE_DESC: Good work; you've managed to buy another Lot in the world before the deadline! But there's still work to be done before the scenario is complete. Keep it up!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_LOTLOSE_DESC: Bad luck; you failed to buy another Lot before the deadline!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_LOTWON_DESC: Ace job! You've succeeded in buying another Lot before the deadline! Nightlife magazine are ecstatic about the good work that you've done, and are awarding you the Gold Star for entertainment excellence! Scenario completed, how about that?
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_NIGHTLIFE_DESC:
Couldn't be simpler: be the first Vegas tycoon to make $10,000 daily profit from their exclusive night-time entertainments. That's anything from the following list of buildings:

  Cocktail Bars
  Nightclubs
  Ballrooms
  Exclusive Nightclubs
  A la Carte Restaurants
  Theaters
  Showgirls
  Live Music Venues
  Stage Shows
  Arenas

You'll be up against three other Vegas tycoons: wealthy widow Grace Morley-Jones, movie mogul Damien G. West, and steel magnate Hal Harding. Good luck, kid!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_NIGHTLIFEDONE_DESC: Good work; you were the first Vegas entrepreneur to make a daily profit of $10,000 from your exclusive night time businesses. You're well on your way to getting that plaudit from Nightlife magazine, but there's still work to be done; no time to rest, buddy!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_NIGHTLIFELOSEP2_DES: Well, it's a washout; Grace Morley-Jones was the first to make $10,000 daily profit on her exclusive night time businesses. This means that you've failed the objective and, because Nightlife magazine have decided to give Ms. Jones the Gold Prize, you've lost the scenario overall. Maybe you could try again?
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_NIGHTLIFELOSEP3_DES: Unlucky! Damien G. West has stormed ahead of the pack; he was the first to make a daily profit of $10,000 from his exclusive night time businesses! Bad news for you, though: you've lost the objective and Nightlife magazine have decided to give Mr. West the Gold Prize. This means you've lost the scenario overall; tough break!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_NIGHTLIFELOSEP4_DES: Unlucky! Hal Harding has stormed ahead of the pack; he was the first to make a daily profit of $10,000 from his exclusive night time businesses! This is pretty bad news all in all: you've lost the objective and Nightlife magazine have decided to award Mr. Harding with the Gold Prize. This means you've failed the scenario. Tough break, kid!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_NIGHTLIFEWON_DESC: Excellent! You were the first to make $10,000 daily profit from your exclusive night time businesses! This was the last objective necessary to beat this scenario; Nightlife Magazine has decided to award you their Gold Star for entertainment excellence. Bingo!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_SIGNS_DESC: Here's another objective you'll need to beat if you want to complete this scenario: by the end of Day Three, make sure you've built two Large Signs. They aren't cheap, but they'll make your Lot MUCH prettier!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_SIGNSDONE_DESC: Good work; you got those Large Signs up before the deadline! But there's still work to do if you want to complete the scenario; keep at it!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_SIGNSLOSE_DESC: Well, the deadline has come and gone, and still no sign of these Large Signs. Unlucky, friend; this means you won't be getting Nightlife's Gold Prize, and you've failed the scenario. Don't say you weren't warned!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OBJ_SIGNSWON_DESC: That's it! You've managed to build those two Large Signs before the deadline. As you've also completed all the other objectives, Nightlife magazine have given you the Gold Star for entertainment excellence and the scenario is beaten. Good job!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_OLDFOLK_DESC: Another group of dancers has hit the Strip! But this time, some of them are here for the Silver Fraternity's Annual Dinner and Dance; in other words, around 60 senior citizens have shown up, looking to rock! But gently.
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_P2CASINO_DESC: Grace Morley-Jones has just built herself a Large Casino, chock full of good stuff to keep the visitors entertained!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_P2HOTEL_DESC: Grace Morley-Jones has noticed that you've built a Large Hotel. She liked it so much, she's decided to build one of her own! Check it out by hitting the link below!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_P2NIGHTCLUB_DESC: Ms. Morley-Jones has just built herself a Classy Nightclub, all the better to find herself someone dumb and rich to seduce! Uh-oh!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_P3CASINO_DESC: Damien G. West has just built himself a Medium Casino! Check it out by clicking the link below!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_P3THEATRE_DESC: Mr. G. West has just built himself a Theater, for the customer with the higher brow. Click the link below to take a look!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_P4CASINO_DESC: Hal Harding has built himself a Medium Casino. Take a look at it by clicking on the link below!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_PLAYER1WON_TEXT: You've won the most customers onto your property by the eighth day! Well done, you are the ace of clubs!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_PLAYER2WON_TEXT: The Wealthy Widow has succeeded in attracting the most customers to her night-time attractions by the end of Day Seven! Unlucky!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_PLAYER2WON_TITLE: Grace Morley-Jones has won the scenario!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_PLAYER3WON_TEXT: The Movie Mogul has succeeded in attracting the most customers to his night-time entertainments by the eighth day! Commiserations!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_PLAYER3WON_TITLE: Damien G. West has won the scenario!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_PLAYER4WON_TEXT: The Steel Tycoon has succeeded in attracting the most customers to his night-time entertainments by the eighth day! Commiserations!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_PLAYER4WON_TITLE: Hal Harding has won the scenario!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_POWER_DESC: Boom! The local power station has been blasted by lightning and has had to increase electricity prices to cover the cost of the damage. What a swizz. Maybe you could get around this problem by doing some judicious building...
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_POWERRISE_TEXT: The local power station has been struck by lightning and the station and has had to increase electricity prices in order to cover the costs of the damage. Maybe you can get round this by building your own power generator?
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_SHOWGIRLS_DESC:
Mr. Harding has just erected a Showgirls' venue! He's thinking of starting up a show called 'Hal's Angels': the story of his own life conveyed through the medium of dance. Man, it looks like that guy is losing the plot...

Click the link below to see this building for yourself!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_STARTUPMESSAGE_DESC:
Nightlife magazine are handing out their yearly awards for best night time entertainment in Vegas. Make sure you take the Gold Star for entertainment excellence, by completing all of the following objectives.

Reach $10,000 daily profit from your exclusive night time businesses before your competitors. That's profit from Cocktail Bars, A la Carte Restaurants, Nightclubs, Exclusive Nightclubs, Ballrooms, Theaters, Showgirls, Live Music Venues, Stage Shows and Arenas.

You'll also need to have spent $8,000 on promoting your complex by the end of Day Three.

And, by the end of Day Six, have built one Arena and one Live Music Venue (There are a couple of big events coming over the next few days, so it's a good idea to get an Arena built as soon as possible).

That's the lot. Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_STARTUPMESSAGE_NAME: Scenario Nine - The Ace of Clubs
ID_SCENARIO_TAOC_TOPLESS_DESC: Man, he loves these places! Hal Harding has just built himself a Topless Revue Bar. Check it out by clicking the link below!
ID_SCENARIO_TESTLEVEL_OBJECTIVE_DESC: Your objective is to create over £10,000 before the end of day 1
ID_SCENARIO_TH_BASEKETBALLHERE_DESC: Maxwell Swift has arrived in Las Vegas. Hope you're ready for him...
ID_SCENARIO_TH_BASKETBALL_DESC:
His name is Maxwell Swift, and they call him the King of the Court. He's in Las Vegas looking for pretty women and good times! Make him happy and he'll tip you to the tune of $3,000!

Find out what he wants by clicking on him and checking out his desires!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_BASKETBALL_NAME: Basketball legend comes to the Strip!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_BASKETBALLLOSE_DESC: It's a low down shame; he didn't enjoy himself a whole lot. Maybe you needed to build a little more of what he was looking for? But hey; some you win, some you lose, right?
ID_SCENARIO_TH_BASKETBALLWARNING_DESC:
Master of the basketball court Maxwell 'Lightning' Swift is on his way to Las Vegas, looking to kick back and get some much needed R & R. He'll be here in three hours, and while he's around, he'll probably be in the mood for movies, soft drinks, a little hardcore relaxation and somewhere he can work out. He also digs the sports book betting, and of course he'll need somewhere to stay.

If he comes to your property and finds what he's looking for, he'll tip you $3,000! Go get him, tiger!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_BASKETBALLWIN_DESC: He had the sweetest time, and by way of expressing his gratitude, he's issued you a check for $3,000! Well, alright!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_BASKETBALLWIN_NAME: Maxwell Swift is leaving your Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_CASINOWARNING_DESC: Hal Harding is getting ready to build his big ol' Casino. It's going to be a monster, so here's hoping you're ready for it!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_CEMENTSHORTAGE_DESC: A stroke of bad luck here: rising local demand for cement means that the price has been jacked up by 20% for one day! All building costs go up by an equivalent amount.
ID_SCENARIO_TH_CEMENTSHORTAGEEND_DESC: Normal building costs will now resume!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_ENTDROP_DESC: Hal Harding has noticed that you've built a few entertainment businesses now, so he's decided to reduce the price of one of his entertainments by 25%! Click the link below to find out which business he's selected!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_FINE_DESC: The Inspectors have looked at your facilities and found them to be below par! Watch out for this kind of thing in future!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_FOUNTAINLOST_DESC: Bad luck, man. Earthmothers didn't find enough fountains on your property, so they're not going to give you any cash. Shame!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_FOUNTAINS_DESC: Real simple: the Earthmothers foundation - a pack of hippy do-gooders - is in town to see how Las Vegas is destroying the environment. Get them off your back by building three Fountains (any size) by 4pm today. If they find you've made this token gesture towards making the world a better place, they'll throw you a $2,000 reward.
ID_SCENARIO_TH_FOUNTAINWON_DESC: Good work: the Earthmothers are thrilled by the sight of three fountains, and have given you the total contents of their pockets. That's about $2,000. Great job!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_INSPECTFINE_DESC:
Hotel Inspectors Report

Number of damaged hotels: %d
Total fine of: %d

Yow! Bad luck, daddio!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_INSPECTHERE_DESC: The Hotel Inspectors have arrived on the Strip, and they're on the prowl! Don't let them find anything to whine about!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_INSPECTNOFINE_DESC: The Hotel Inspectors have left the Strip. They found no problems with any of your hotels! Great job there!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_INSPECTORS_DESC: A pack of twenty Hotel Inspectors are coming to town in one day. Any hotel found to be at 30% of its optimum health or lower will incur a $1,000 fine!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_INSPECTORS_NAME: Hotel Inspectors coming to the Strip!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_INSPECTWARNING_DESC: Hotel Inspectors are going to be doing the Vegas rounds in a little under three hours. Any hotels found to be 0% health will incur a $1,000 fine per hotel. Make sure they're up to scratch!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_NOFINE_DESC: No fine levied against you! Excellent!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_NOFINE_NAME: The Hotel Inspectors have found no cause for concern on your property. Good job!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_ARENA_ALREADYDONE_DES: Hey, that's pretty good work there: you got your Stage Show built before your deadline was up! As you've completed the other two objectives this scenario's already beaten, but that's still a pretty good job. Well done!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_ARENA_DESC: By the end of Day Three you need to have built a Stage Show. These don't come cheap, but you'll find they're worth every cent.
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_ARENA_WON_DESC: You've built a Stage Show and beaten Mr Hal Harding to the $4,000 casino profit prize. You've hit the jackpot, tiger! Good work!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_ARENADONE_DESC:
Excellent! You've built your Stage Show by the deadline! But here's a new objective you're going to have to take on if you want to complete this scenario: by the end of Day Five, try and make 300 'Entertainment' sales. That's anything from the following businesses:

  Cinemas
  Theaters
  Aquariums
  Dolphin Pools
  Circuses
  Topless Revues
  Showgirls
  Museums
  Magic Shows
  Shark Pools
  Stage Shows

Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_ARENAFAIL_DESC: Well, you didn't build your Stage Show in time, so that's this objective failed. But be cool; if you can make $4,000 daily casino profit ahead of Hal Harding, you're still in with a chance!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_ARENAFAIL_LOSE_DESC: Well, you've blown it; you've failed to build a Stage Show by the deadline. Tough luck, kid. But hey, you can always have another try, right?
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_BASKETBALL_DESC:
Master of the basketball court Maxwell 'Lightning' Swift is on his way to Las Vegas, looking to kick back and get some much needed R & R. While he's in town, he'll be looking for:

  Movies
  Soft Drinks
  Relaxation
  Somewhere to get some exercise
  Sports Book betting
  Medium Hotel

If he comes to your Lot and finds what he's looking for, he'll tip you $3,000!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_CASINOPROFIT_DESC: Be the first player to make a profit of $4,000 from your casinos! But look out; steel magnate Hal Harding is going to be trying for the same objective, and he's pretty good!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_CASINOPROFITDONE_DESC: You've beaten Hal Harding to the draw, making $4,000 profit ahead of him! That's pretty good work! But there's still work to be done; keep at it!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_CASINOPROFITDONE_LOSE: Hal Harding has beaten you to the punch, and was the first to make $4,000 from his casino complex. That means you've lost this scenario. But cheer up, Bucko; you can always try again, right? Betcha do better next time!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_CASINOPROFITDONE_WON_: You've made a profit of $4,000 from your casino complex ahead of Hal Harding! That's all objectives completed, and the scenario beaten. Good work!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_DAILYPROFIT_DESC: Be the first player to make a daily profit of $12,000
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_ENTERTAINMENT_DESC:
To complete this scenario, you'll need to beat the following objective: by the end of Day Three, spend at least $8,000 on Entertainment buildings. That's anything from the following building types:

  Cinemas
  Theaters
  Aquariums
  Dolphin Pools
  Circuses
  Topless Revues
  Showgirls
  Museums
  Magic Shows
  Shark Pools
  Stage Shows

Good luck!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_ENTERTAINMENT_DONE_DE: Great job; you've spent $8,000 on Entertainment before the deadline! But now there's a new objective you'll need to complete if you want to beat this scenario: by the end of Day Five try and make 500 'entertainment' sales! Best of luck, kid!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_ENTERTAINMENT_LOSE_DE: Tough luck, chum: you failed to spend $8,000 on Entertainment businesses by the deadline, so you've failed this scenario. But hey, you can always have another crack at it, right?
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_ENTERTAINMENT_WON_DES: Excellent work: you've spent at least $8,000 on Entertainment before the deadline! That's the final objective beaten, and the scenario complete! Give yourself a pat on the back, kiddo!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_FOUNTAINS_DESC: Real simple: the Earthmothers foundation - a pack of hippy do-gooders - is in town to see how Las Vegas is destroying the environment. Get them off your back by building three Fountains (any size) by 4pm today. If they find you've made this token gesture towards making the world a better place, they'll throw you a $2,000 reward. How'd you like them apples?
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_INSPECTORS_DESC: A pack of twenty hotel inspectors will be doing the rounds as of 1pm on Day Three. Make sure your hotels are all above 0% health, or it'll be a $1,000 fine per hotel.
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_P2BETCHANGE_DESC: Hal Harding has noticed that you're doing pretty well from your casinos, so he's decided to up the bet range on all of his tables by one 'notch'. He's determined to wring as much cash as he can from his visitors!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_P2EDGECHANGE_DESC: Hal Harding has noticed that you're doing pretty well from your casinos, so he's decided to up the house edge on all of his tables by one 'notch'. He's determined to wring as much cash as he can from the unwitting punters!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_ROCKGOD_DESC:
Secret Agent Commander Nathan Kane is coming to town! He has very expensive tastes, and is prone to getting into fights with Russian assassins, so things could get a little ugly... Here's some of what he's after while he's in Las Vegas:

  Topless Revue
  Cocktail Bar (plus Waitress)
  A la Carte Restaurant
  Exclusive Nightclub
  Masseuse
  Personal Trainer
  Baccarat
  Medium/Large Hotel

Keep him pleasantly diverted on his trip and Her Majesty's Secret Service will happily reimburse you to the tune of $8,000 for your trouble!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_SALES_ALREADYDONE_DES: Hey, you've had 500 customers come visit your shows! That's the final objective for this scenario completed; good job!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_SALES_DESC:
By the end of Day Five you need to make 500 Entertainment sales. That's a sale made from any of the following buildings:

  Cinema
  Theater
  Aquarium
  Dolphin Pool
  Circus
  Topless Revue
  Showgirls
  Museum
  Magic Show
  Shark Pool
  Stage Show

Best of luck!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_SALES_WON_DESC: Oh yes! You've had 500 customers come visit your shows! That's all objectives completed, and the scenario beaten. Good job!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_SALESDONE_DESC:
That's great: you've managed to get 500 customers to your shows! Your stirling efforts have come to the attention of High Times magazine, who are rewarding your work with an $8,000 cash prize! Excellent!

But remember, you've still got to hit that $4,000 Casino profit before Hal Harding gets there. No time to hang around, daddio!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_SALESFAIL_DESC: You've failed to get 500 customers to your shows by the deadline! Bad luck, chum. That's this scenario failed, sad to say.
ID_SCENARIO_TH_OBJ_SALESFAIL_LOSE_DESC: That's it, it's over. You failed to get 500 customers to your shows, so you've lost the scenario. Bad luck, man. But hey, you can always try again, right?
ID_SCENARIO_TH_P2AQUARIUM_DESC: Hal Harding has just built himself an Aquarium. He loves them little fishies!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_P2CASINO_DESC: Hal Harding has done built himself a big ol' casino. Take a look at it by clicking on the button below!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_P2CINEMA_DESC: Hal Harding has built himself a Cinema. He's guaranteeing 'High Noon' and 'Shane' twenty-four hours a day!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_P2TOPLESS_DESC: That is to say, Hal Harding has just built himself a Topless Revue bar. These act as a big pull on a certain kind of customer...
ID_SCENARIO_TH_P2TOPLESS2_DESC: Hal Harding has just built his SECOND Topless Revue bar. He sure loves those ladies!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_PLAYER1WON_DESC: Well done, you were the first player to hit the target daily profit! Excellent job!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_PLAYER2WON_DESC: The boorish steel magnate was the first to hit the target daily profit. Bad luck!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_ROCKDUDEHERE_DESC: Secret Agent Commander Nathan Kane has arrived in town! Click the button below to find out where he is and what he's doing!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_ROCKDUDEHERE_NAME: Secret Agent Nathan Kane is in town!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_ROCKDUDELOSE_DESC: He hasn't had a great time: no super-villains to be defeated, no secret bases to be blown up. There's nothing you could have done about that of course, but maybe you could have built more to keep him diverted? He's decided that he won't be back any time soon, and Her Majesty's going to hang onto that $8,000 for the time being. Tough luck!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_ROCKDUDELOSE_NAME: Nathan Kane is leaving the Strip
ID_SCENARIO_TH_ROCKDUDEWIN_DESC:
He had a great time, and also found time to stop a super-villain's plan to destroy America with his revolutionary 'laser' gun! By way of thanks, here's a check for $8,000 signed by the Queen of England herself. How about that?

Nathan Kane will return!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_ROCKDUDEWIN_NAME: Nathan Kane has left your Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_ROCKGOD_DESC:
Keep it under your hat, but the word is that Great Britain's foremost gentleman spy Commander Nathan Kane is on his way to Las Vegas in nine hours time, having been tipped off about some dastardly plan or other. He's infamous for his expensive tastes, and is also prone to getting into fights with Russian assassins, so expect trouble! His tastes are many and varied, but there's a good chance that, while he's here, he'll be on the lookout for beautiful women (sans clothing), cocktails (shaken, not... well, you get the idea), haute cuisine, and somewhere he can, if necessary, 'funk out'. He also has a real fondness for Baccarat, likes exotic massage, and will doubtless want to do a little working out while he's here.

Keep him pleasantly diverted, and Her Majesty's Secret Service will happily reimburse you to the tune of $8,000 for your trouble!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_ROCKLOSENOARENA_DESC: As you failed to build an arena, the self-styled God of Goth will not be performing his gig on your property. Unlucky!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_ROCKLOSENOARENA_NAME: Magnus Carter will not be performing on your Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_ROCKLOSENOUPGRADE_DESC: As you neglected to upgrade your arena with a Rock Legend feature, the self-styled God of Goth will not be performing his gig on your property. Bad luck!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_ROCKLOSENOUPGRADE_NAME: Magnus Carter will not be performing on your Lot!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_ROCKWIN_DESC: He's performing on your Lot right now, and his show's going down a storm! Good work!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_SHOWBROADWAYFOLK_DESC: Word that you're staging a Broadway spectacular has swept across the Strip! Loads of people are very excited to see a top-class piece of showbusiness. Expect some of the following: the elderly, girls, and mothers. And you know how sentimental newly-weds can be, so expect a few of those as well!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_SHOWMUSICALFOLK_DESC: Word that you're staging a big old Musical has spread across the Strip! Expect a flood of people (primarily retired men and women, girls and mothers) looking for sweet melodies and good times!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_SHOWSFXFOLK_DESC: Word that you're staging a Special Effects show has spread across the Strip! Expect loads of people (mostly bikers and their girlfriends, skaters, single guys, boys and dads) to turn up on your Lot looking for an awesome lightshow!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_STARTUPMESSAGE_DESC:
This time around you need to make a daily profit of $4,000 from your casinos! As you strive for this goal, you'll find yourself up against some stiff opposition from the boorish (but whip-smart) steel magnate Hal Harding. If he reaches this target first the scenario will be lost, so stay sharp!
