As well as beating Harding to the prize, you'll also need to complete the following objective: by the end of Day Three, spend at least $8,000 on Entertainment buildings. That's anything from the following building types:

  Cinemas
  Theaters
  Aquariums
  Dolphin Pools
  Circuses
  Topless Revues
  Showgirls
  Museums
  Magic Shows
  Shark Pools
  Stage Shows

Good luck!
ID_SCENARIO_TH_STARTUPMESSAGE_NAME: Scenario Three - Top of the Heap
ID_SCENARIO_WS_BUILDELECHUTNIGHTCLUB:
Now, whenever you need to make a repair on this building, just click on the building, then press the spanner button to call the Mechanic. The Mechanic will then come out and make repairs on your building.

Different types of building require different types of repair: you'd need an electrician to repair an Arcade or Nightclub, so an Electrician's Hut would need to be built.

Build one Nightclub and one Electrician's Hut now, making sure their entrances connect to existing path.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_BUILDINGBEAUTY_TEXT:
Great! 

The more beautiful your Lot, the more attractive it'll be to visitors. Those visitors, when on a beautiful Lot, will be more likely to spend their cash there. For more info on which features qualify as beauty items, go to the Objectives panel and click on the Info button for this task. Place two items from the Furniture and Garden sections of the Scenery menu in the world now.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_BUILDINGS_TEXT:
Well done: your first guest has arrived!

Select your Small Hotel and take a look at the panel below to see information about it. From here, it's possible to find out everything you need to know about your new building; you'll also be able to tweak the price of the service you offer to your guests. Most buildings allow you this amount of control.

Once you've got two more guests at your Hotel, we'll look at how some other buildings work.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_BUILDJEWELLERYSTORE: Good job. Now select the Head Office and use the upgrade button to switch on the Retail Division upgrade. Once you've done that, you'll be able to build your Souvenir Shop. Do this now, and bear in mind that you'll need to make other upgrades to the Head Office in order to erect other types of building. We'll move onto the next section once you've made 3 souvenir sales.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_BUYMOTEL_TEXT:
Now you've bought your first Lot, let's look at how to build on it.

With the Lot selected, click on the Build button. Then, using the tooltips to help you navigate through the panel below, find the Infrastructure/Accomodation section. Once there, select the Small Hotel, and place it in the world.

VERY IMPORTANT: once you've built one or more buildings, it's vital that you build paths that connect these buildings to each other, as well as ensuring that at least one of these buildings is connected to the sidewalk. Without this, the visitors won't be able to get from one building to another, and your Lot will quickly wither and die. Find path types in the Infrastucture/Paths section of the Build menu.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_DONTSELLTHEHOTEL_DESC: That Small Hotel is essential for this scenario! Don't sell it off!
ID_SCENARIO_WS_DONTSELLTHESTORE_DESC: That Souvenir Shop is essential for this scenario! Don't sell it off!
ID_SCENARIO_WS_MAINTENANCE_TEXT:
Well done, you've made three souvenir sales!

Over time, most of your buildings will decay. Allow them to decay too much and those buildings will become run down and eventually unusable. To prevent this happening, you'll need to build a Mechanic's Hut or Mechanics' Department. To do this, just go to the Infrastructure/Staff buildings section of the Build menu below, select either of these from the list, and then place the building you've chosen, making sure you connect its entrance to an existing path.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_MOREBUILDINGS_TEXT:
Good work!

Some building types can't be built until you have built or upgraded others. If you were to try and build a Souvenir Shop right now, you would find that the button for this shop type is greyed out, and can't be pressed. To build your Souvenir Shop, you'll first need to build a Head Office. Find this building type in the 'Infrastructure/Facilities' section of the menu below.

Make sure you build a path to link this building to your existing building, and ensure that there is a path linking your building group to the sidewalk!
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJ_ATTRACTGUESTS_DESC: Attract a total of 50 guests onto your lot at the same time!
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJ_ATTRACTGUESTS_NAME: GET A TOTAL OF 50 GUESTS ONTO YOUR LOT
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJ_BUILDELECHUTNIGHTCLUB: Build a Cinema and an Electrician's Hut. You'll find the Cinema in the Entertainment section of the Recreations menu, and the Electrician's Hut can be found in the Maintenance Staff section of the Infrastructure menu.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJ_BUILDFIVETHINGS_DESC:
Build five different types of building, and after building each one, use the View Filters to study their effect on the people in the world. You can find the View Filters button on the left side of the panel below. Once in the View Filters panel, here's how each filter works

  - Use the 'People' button to track the different people types

  - Use the 'Gambling' button to see which gambling facilities are being offered and where they might be found

 - The 'Non-gambling' button helps you find all shop, service and facility types

 - 'Affecters' lets you see how the world is being affected by things like smell, noise, beauty etc.

 - 'Supplies' lets you look at which services are currently being offered in the world.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJ_BUILDHEADOFFICE_DESC: Build a Head Office. You can find this building type in the Facilities section of the Infrastructure menu below. Remember to build a path linking this building to the hotel!
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJ_BUILDJEWELLERYSTORE_D: Build a Souvenir Shop. You can find this shop type in the Shops section of the Retail menu in the panel below. Before you can build it however, you'll need to equip your Head Office with the Retail upgrade. Do this by clicking on your Head Office, pressing the upgrade button in the panel below then selecting 'Retail Division' from the available upgrades.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJ_BUILDMECHHUT_DESC: You can find the Mechanic's Hut or Department building types in the Staff Buildings section of the Infrastructure menu in the panel below.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJ_BUILDTHREEBEAUTYTHING: Place two Beauty Items in the world. You can find Trees, Plants and Fountains in the Gardens section of the Scenery menu, and Statues can be found in the Display section of the same menu.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJ_BUYLOT_DESC: Your first task is to buy a Lot. To do this, just find the only available Lot in the world and click on it. Then press the Buy button in the panel below. You'll then be asked to choose the theme in which you'd like to build. This decision will determine the style of all of the buildings erected on this Lot.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJ_BUYMOTEL_DESC: Build a Small Hotel. First, click the Build button in the panel below, then use the tooltips to find your way to the Infrastructure/Accomodation section, which can be found in the same panel. Then, simply select the right Hotel type, then place it in the world.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJ_FIRSTSALE_DESC: Wait for the first guest to arrive at your Small Hotel. While you're waiting, have a play around with the panel below, and try out some different building types.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJ_FIVEGUESTS_DESC: Wait for another two guests to arrive at your Small Hotel. This shouldn't take too long!
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJ_FIVEJEWELLERYSALES_DE: Make three sales from your Souvenir Shop. To improve your chances of success, why not look into how much this store's goods will cost the public, and think about reducing the price to make those goods more attractive? Also, remember that you'll need to build a path to link this building to at least one other building on your Lot.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_OBJECTIVE_TEXT: Now it's time to tackle the scenario proper! Your challenge this time is to get 50 people onto your Lot at the same time. Do whatever you can to attract visitors to your shops and services!
ID_SCENARIO_WS_PATHREMINDER:
Well done.

As with the Small Hotel and Head Office, make sure you build a path to link this building to your others.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_PATHS_TEXT: Great. Now, to allow people to get into your building you will need to build a path from the entrance to the sidewalk. While still in Build mode, go to the  'Infrastructure/Paths' section, choose a path type then drag a line of paving from the entrance to the sidewalk. After that, you just need to wait for your first guest to arrive.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_SETTINGPRICES_TEXT:
Well done!

If you click on any of your businesses you'll be able to change the price of the service this business offers. Find the 'Goods' section and click the left or right button to raise or lower the price of your service. Lowering price can be a handy strategy when you want to improve your sales. Try tweaking the prices on a few of your buildings and see what effect it has on your customers.

This is the last tutorial panel for this scenario. In a moment, you can begin to tackle the first objective!
ID_SCENARIO_WS_TUTORIALCONTROL_TEXT:
This is Vegas: Make it Big! Welcome!

We're going to start off with a few tips to help you through the game's features and controls. If, while playing through the scenario, you get lost or confused, just click the Objective Button in the top left, then press 'i' for Information.

Shall we begin?
ID_SCENARIO_WS_VIEWFILTERS_TEXT:
Good work!

You can always get an idea of which services the buildings in the world offer, how popular those buildings are, how healthy they are etc. by using the View Filters. Just press the 'View Filters' button in the panel below to access these.

Spend a little time becoming acquainted with this panel, then build five buildings (of any type) and use the Filters to see how these affect the people. If you need more advice on this, go to the Objectives button and press the information button.
ID_SCENARIO_WS_WELCOME: Welcome to VEGA$: Make it BIG! Before you attempt the objective for this level, do you want to play through a tutorial?
ID_SCENARIO_WS_WELLDONE: Scenario completed! You successfully attracted an extra 50 visitors to your Lot! But greater challenges await!
ID_SCENARIO_WS_YOURWORLD_TEXT:
From this view, you can see the area in which you're playing. You can go back to this view at any time by pressing the 'World View' button in the panel below. From here you can see all of the lots in the playing area. Hover over them for some basic information, and click on them to zoom in.

Zoom in now and spend some time getting a feel for the camera control. Use your right mouse button to rotate the camera and the left button to select and move to an object. Move to the edge of the screen to nudge the view left or right.
When you're ready, select an the only available Lot and press the 'Buy' button.

Once done, you'll be able to choose the theme in which you want to build.
